economy.zh:
全球经济在过去24小时呈现明显的“避险”与“结构分化”特征。芯片股的全球性抛售从韩国蔓延至美股和A股，成为最核心的压力线；与此同时，美伊紧张局势的暂时缓和推动油价大幅回落，缓解了部分通胀担忧。中国CXMT的IPO暴涨与A股科技股暴跌形成鲜明对比，暗示市场对国产替代的极端炒作与对行业基本面的担忧并存。欧洲方面，油价下跌提振了股市，但ECB官员继续释放加息信号。以下是本日要点：

- **全球芯片股遭遇系统性抛售**：韩国SK Hynix单日暴跌13%，拖累Kospi指数一度触发熔断，纳斯达克100与Kospi的60天相关性升至2021年以来最高（约0.50）。[详情](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/skhynix-plunges-semiconductor-selloff-deepens-samsung-softbank.html)
- **美伊冲突现缓和曙光，油价大跌**：特朗普暂停对伊朗的打击行动，布伦特原油一度跌破88美元/桶，跌幅超9%，航空、运输板块受益。[报道](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/27/oil-prices-fall-us-strikes-iran-brent-crude-bp-shell-ftse-100)
- **苹果重夺全球市值第一**：苹果收盘市值超越英伟达，后者自2025年6月以来一直占据榜首。这一轮换反映了市场从AI算力硬件向消费电子龙头的偏好转移。[来源](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/apple-most-valuable-company-nvidia.html)
- **中国CXMT IPO首日暴涨466%，市值超工商银行**：长鑫存储成为A股最大市值公司，但全球DRAM股（如美光）同步下跌，跨市场定价出现严重背离。[详情](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362014/fortune-roller-coaster-elon-musk-loses-us130b-chinese-chip-and-ai-founders-gain)
- **A股创业板暴跌5.37%，AI硬件方向领跌**：同花顺数据显示兆易创新、东山精密等龙头触及跌停，资金从AI硬件向新材料等防御板块迁移。[数据](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE91WnI1eUhrNVpSVFBJcWFVT0tJN0pSQ0Exck04QlR6Q2VTZlh2UjlhaDk3LUN6THRxLWc3YXRWOGF6VVRMa1R4Znk0R0trYXpVdkVkRmVnVTI0bzFZN2c)
- **欧洲股市收高，ECB官员仍坚持鹰派立场**：Stoxx 600上涨，但ECB委员Kazimir表示即使经济前景改善，9月加息仍可能必要。[报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOWTZQYWhqU3duUVJfbGppeGtlTFpmYTNmNjBnZTk2dzY4TkxKaFRBd2NocmgzUTQ5a3Axa3FGYS1yVS1FWmJkd1JaaUZISTFFWWl5Z2xGTU8xTXp1bDcwTmlhTGVscVFxZ2lJaGFxSDI1QjJVaEVYa0ZkTjlJbkR6cVhXc1BWTHJHVVRjY2RuTzMxMk1SbzRERlBQMG55UGtwWlhEY2Z5LXFSbGJpX3lKaTNTTnppS28)
- **Michael Burry增加AI股空头仓位，挑战中国股市支撑**：知名空头Michael Burry加大对英伟达、美光等的看空押注，而中国股市正面临国家资金能否持续托市的考验。[分析](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361950/big-short-trader-michael-burrys-rising-bearish-ai-positions-test-chinas-stock-support)

**后续观察**：芯片板块的抛售是否触发更广泛的技术性回调，将取决于本周美联储主席Warsh的讲话基调以及美伊局势的下一步走向。中国CXMT的暴涨一旦出现回调，可能对整个半导体板块产生负反馈。欧洲能源通胀是否因油价下跌而实质性缓解，将决定ECB后续加息路径。
economy.en:
Global markets are caught in a dual shock this morning: a deep semiconductor rout that originated in Seoul and spilled into U.S. and Asian equities, and a sharp decline in oil prices after the U.S. signaled a pause in strikes on Iran. The chip sell-off, led by SK Hynix's 13% plunge, erased billions in market cap and triggered a trading halt on South Korea's Kospi. Meanwhile, China's memory chip maker CXMT staged a stunning 466% debut, becoming the country's largest listed firm by market value, highlighting a stark divergence in AI-related bets. European stocks rose as lower oil prices lifted risk appetite, while the ECB signaled further rate hikes ahead. Investors are rotating into defensive sectors and watching for signals from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh later this week.

- **Chip rout deepens:** SK Hynix shares fell 13% in Seoul, dragging the Kospi down 8% and triggering a circuit breaker ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/sk-hynix-plunges-semiconductor-selloff-deepens-samsung-softbank.html)). The sell-off extended to U.S. markets, with Nvidia losing its crown as the world's most valuable company to Apple ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/apple-most-valuable-company-nvidia.html)).
- **Oil drops 9% on U.S.-Iran de-escalation:** Brent crude fell below $88/barrel after President Trump indicated a pause in hostilities, easing fears of a supply disruption in the Strait of Hormuz ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/27/oil-prices-fall-us-strikes-iran-brent-crude-bp-shell-ftse-100)).
- **CXMT's record IPO:** ChangXin Memory Technologies surged 466% on its Shanghai debut, valuing it at 3.3 trillion yuan, surpassing ICBC. Nomura sees potential for the stock to double again as the firm targets 18% global DRAM market share by 2028 ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3362012/what-cxmt-must-do-grow-global-memory-market-share-and-build-its-surge-analysts)).
- **U.S.-Korea tech correlation worry:** The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 hit 0.50, the highest since 2021, raising concerns about contagion risk for global portfolios ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/nasdaq-kospi-wall-street-korea-markets-skhynox-samsung.html)).
- **European stocks rally on oil relief:** The STOXX 600 closed higher as falling crude boosted consumer discretionary and transport sectors ([Investing.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPUGE2dk1Ld1V3QVJCZzI3RXFIeGRfRTZGUkV5MHQxWW1aNmZ5RUQ4VkdZRGZSaTliZWllLVNXY2diaXFDYjZWU01HRkxkTWF4VklJQ2VPSTgwYVQtdDByNzdqZjdBODdqWkZvMlA4RUdFbHhGdXNVUXJqSGszUHBEblJTdWtQbjJNeFRyalF0UzlzeUtTd0dvSW0xSFFGbG03bUFGNEJHdlVoUTktSFJpUFZIWnlQdmRuanFJZkdjYm4wYzVVOUE)).
- **ECB hawkish:** ECB Governing Council member Kazimir said a September rate hike is likely needed even if the outlook improves ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOWTZQYWhqU3duUVJfbGppeGtlTFpmYTNmNjBnZTk2dzY4TkxKaFRBd2NocmgzUTQ5a3Axa3FGYS1yVS1FWmJkd1JaaUZISTFFWWl5Z2xGTU8xTXp1bDcwTmlhTGVscVFxZ2lJaGFxSDI1QjJVaEVYa0ZkTjlJbkR6cVhXc1BWTHJHVVRjY2RuTzMxMk1SbzRERlBQMG55UGtwWlhEY2Z5LXFSbGJpX3lKaTNTTnppS28)).
- **LVMH signals luxury recovery:** Fashion and leather division reported 1% organic growth in Q2, ending seven quarters of decline, a positive sign for the sector's exposure to Chinese demand ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362057/lvmhs-fashion-and-leather-division-reports-1-organic-growth-second-quarter)).

**Watch next:** All eyes are on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference this week. Prediction markets suggest he will address last week's oil supply shock ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/from-oil-to-shock-heres-what-kalshi-traders-expect-warsh-to-say.html)). Separately, the Hong Kong IPO of CATL-backed NASN Intelligent Tech could test investor appetite for smart-driving plays. The divergence between Western AI hardware stocks and Chinese memory chip stocks will be a key narrative this week.

society.zh:
## 社会新闻 · 日报

**2026年7月28日 | 全球安全、气候灾难与技术伦理三线交汇**

过去24小时，社会新闻板块呈现多重张力：美伊冲突在军事打击暂停与外交试探中摇摆，乌克兰攻击伊朗船只将两场战争直接相连；亚洲极端降雨引发跨国洪灾，波及阿富汗至台湾；中国AI虚假视频在自然灾害中泛滥，日韩则用AI摄像头预警自杀。以下是各区域关键动态。

- **美伊谈判真假交织**：特朗普称“谈判正在进行”，伊朗却否认直接对话，而美国参议院即将就对俄制裁投票，乌克兰总统泽连斯基赴美会晤特朗普。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62xn4vzmnpo) [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/28/ukraines-zelenskyy-set-to-meet-trump-as-iran-and-ukraine-wars-converge) 指出，乌克兰袭击伊朗船只的事件使两场战争“直接交汇”，可能导致中东与东欧战线联动升级。
- **法国波尔多逼近火线**：森林大火距波尔多仅9英里，已有超30万人撤离，市长警告“灾难性”局面。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg34128nvpo) 报道居民描述“火焰之墙”，这是南欧夏季野火的最新一例。
- **亚洲暴雨肆虐**：从阿富汗到台湾，十多天不间断降雨引发洪水和台风，一名阿富汗工人称“从未见过这样的雨”，凸显气候崩溃对脆弱地区的冲击。[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/jul/28/extreme-rainfall-asia-flash-floods-typhoons-climate-change)
- **韩国芯片股暴跌**：SK海力士跌破美股发行价，韩股科技板块领跌亚洲市场，原因是市场担忧中国竞争加剧。[The Standard](https://news.google.)
- **假视频借天灾蔓延**：中国暴雨季节中，AI生成的虚假灾害视频在社交媒体泛滥，BBC称这是“中国的新挑战”。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx27mjvxgg1o)
- **多伦多美国领事馆再遭枪击**：今年第二次枪击事件，嫌疑人驾车逃逸未捕获，此前6月已有类似袭击。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckgvnw44rz9o)

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的“谈判窗口”可能极其短暂——若伊朗对乌克兰船只的报复落地，美国暂停的空袭或将重启；而法国山火与亚洲洪水的同步性再次提醒，全球气候适应机制远未跟上极端事件频次。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have witnessed a dangerous convergence of conflicts as the US-Iran military standoff bleeds into the Ukraine war, while climate-driven disasters batter Europe and Asia. Key developments include Trump's confirmation of ongoing talks with Iran amid a pause in airstrikes, Ukraine's strike on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea, and France facing a catastrophic wildfire threatening Bordeaux. In Asia, South Korea and Japan grapple with forced labor heritage disputes and a tech stock rout, while AI-generated disinformation is compounding natural disaster response in China. Below is a curated analysis of the most consequential social news from each desk.

- **Escalating US-Iran conflict: Diplomatic off-ramp or wider war?** Trump says talks are taking place during a pause in US strikes, but Iran denies direct negotiations. Meanwhile, Ukraine's attack on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea has drawn threats from Tehran, and Zelenskyy is set to meet Trump as the two conflicts converge ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62xn4vzmnpo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/28/ukraines-zelenskyy-set-to-meet-trump-as-iran-and-ukraine-wars-converge)). The US Senate will vote on Russian sanctions Tuesday, adding another layer of geopolitical tension.
- **France wildfire: 9 miles from Bordeaux – evacuations and 'catastrophic' warnings.** A wildfire has advanced to within 9 miles of the city of Bordeaux, with the mayor preparing for further evacuations. Over 300,000 people have been forced to flee, and witnesses describe a 'wall of flames' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg34128nvpo), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly5qwwdvr1o)). This comes as extreme rainfall across Asia triggers flash floods and typhoons, highlighting the global impact of climate breakdown.
- **AI-driven disinformation and surveillance: China and South Korea.** China faces a new challenge of fake AI videos spreading during natural disasters, exploiting public anxiety ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx27mjvxgg1o)). In South Korea, AI-powered cameras are being used to spot suicide attempts in Seoul, reflecting a dual-use trend in AI for public safety ([Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNdmNrYU9YS09lNGFJN29nUHhKQmhEWHNPRWNUdlJ0X1BIS3d3c09Nd29jNVl1NVNILVQ5ZVlaY3pFVjkxLUxIV1llRXQxYXF2ekRMdERKN2Utc2I3VXpfQ1RGSUt1aUtlRmhvRjlrNU5aRjJWYWlTMlllc0tJamRkdXhRaWxXWE5qdTJHUWhkZVhTVWxvV3pPVy1Hd2FwX01qZWc)).
- **Korean chip stocks plunge amid China competition fears.** SK Hynix shares fell below their US listing price, leading a tech rout in Seoul and Tokyo ([France 24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOVkVMTDZROUpyamw4Z0xKOTdPUEVtRG5lSERpdk9DT1RYU1JrUV84NTdvNDFZQzlSWHpMUEplRVRFSnRqa1pIVnZlWHVwV3RQUHRVVmtlMnpjbmVuSGowOHAxSjVkUFo5Uml3UDg5Q0NpTFR4ajlfY20tQlVZUXluUmk3eEFOaXZHaEJzeFFFZ3BFMXFsbzU0aHpQcDlhbFdOWFQ2MXgzVmcteVdNc2c)). The sell-off underscores growing anxiety over China's semiconductor self-sufficiency and trade tensions.
- **South Korea demands Japan reflect forced labor history at heritage sites.** In a sharp diplomatic move, Seoul is pressing Tokyo to acknowledge forced labor at UNESCO heritage sites, reopening a historical wound ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPVDYwQ0Y2c0xjQm1Ya3ZWMXVNQWVUeG9PZjdvZEVVdXBWcUJMMldyY1lUTjJsXzM2ZmVaVHRSMkw4TXpCeHJLNDN0M1U4VVNXZS1uS2Z1ZGNVeGhBdTFwamRKWXdhMlFiUlZGc2d1S1JBMjBmOXlXVDBDRG96OWJScTA0d3NZaWdyX01ZVg)). This reflects broader tensions in Northeast Asia.
- **Japan's integration challenges: First mosque protest and foreign worker influx.** A Japanese town wrestles with its identity after protests over its first mosque, as the nation increasingly depends on foreign workers ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c36d79nd5w8o)). Separately, Japan's PM stands firm on LDP-JIP ties while noting public concern over foreign influx ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQYkl3ZEFSbkx1Zm11aGdadVMyX202bzJndnYxaHd2b1FOcFhFY0hQVFJmeURhWEJMMUl2c1R3S09ONjhpWVY0RnlEOGR0RU5mVWt0VDlUMU9VX2JoWkZiSUhfYkpnSWFZenA3TjUwcjBBTFpXT1h0c09lWW5qTHlDTnhsUVRjRlJ4cEUzRg)).

**Watch next:** The US-Iran diplomatic window is fragile; any misstep could trigger a wider Middle East crisis. Meanwhile, the European heatwave and wildfires will test emergency services in the coming days. Investors should monitor the Korean semiconductor sector as China's chip ambitions reshape global supply chains.

military.zh:
过去24小时，全球军事格局出现罕见的多线联动：**乌克兰袭击伊朗货船**这一事件将俄乌冲突与中东战事直接挂钩，引发伊朗警告与美方干预；同时美伊虽暂停直接交火，但拦截导弹库存告急，胡塞武装对沙特石油设施的打击令曼德海峡航运骤降。中国在台海与南海同步动作——直升机无人机首度同时越过台海中线，并在南海救起47名越南船员；印太方向，美军“乔治·华盛顿”号航母打击群在菲中冲突后进入南海，RIMPAC演习中多型无人作战系统完成实战化测试。以下为各子专栏详情。

- **[乌克兰袭击里海伊朗货船](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9kclNGanpMR2VsLWxFUkJ4MV93clhmWlNiaXVxUDM0V3F0em93VXpLMVRCQ3doYk43Uzk1VXhtNFd2VkZhYlIxR1dNVk5VZWltNEFmR2dkR25GMmd1ZHFjT3E1YzdpSkZo)**：乌克兰无人机打击伊朗“沙希德”级货船，造成人员伤亡，伊朗警告将报复，白宫罕见批评乌方行动可能扩大冲突。
- **[美伊暂停交火但弹药告急](https://news.google.)**：特朗普淡化拦截弹库存不足的担忧，但战区分析称美在中东的防空弹药消耗速度超过补充速度。
- **[胡塞袭击沙特油田致曼德海峡航运暴跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQQVdVczhwSnNKSzdFZVhYQUZmZXJXaDdBS2RBVEtOVmx5VXg3dzNDdTV6b2EtRC1DazNUVXp1bkhyaThLUDAySTBHbWg5aXVfU2hoMVU1S1B2aGdrbm0xVjFoREwtRlZScHMyaE9uTTRWaVVvWGRKYWZtTi1mWFNTRGRDTDhkeUVPOUVTUTVMYml3enpZODI5RGRSMzgtRDhWal9rUHE1NnRqT1Q2eFhsWA)**：胡塞武装用无人机和导弹打击沙特阿美设施，曼德海峡船舶通行量下降超30%。
- **[中国军机首次同时越过台海中线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdkpDbEVHbWVtZFN2RXJFMGtCTnVYaUw3NVdwdWZTY0pFcEM5WUZoejZackNZSFJPeVhORkIzeEdFTmlla2Zvb0h0X0dnNERnSkhmLW1NRXdEZW9VblZaM1Zib01GTXRGM1o1OHJzZ09fRFVHZm5kd1NnSUJZYS1mQXdzWXRBOWs)**：据韩媒报道，解放军直升机与无人机同时进入台“管控区域”，属首次，台海局势进一步紧张。
- **[美军“乔治·华盛顿”号航母进入南海](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/george-washington-csg-in-the-south-china-sea-after-philippine-chinese-clashes)**：在中菲海上冲突后，美前进部署航母战斗群已穿越巴士海峡进入南海，USNI News称其位置敏感。
- **[RIMPAC演练自杀式无人艇击沉两栖攻击舰](https://www.twz.com/sea/navys-garc-kamikaze-drone-boat-blew-a-hole-in-ex-uss-peleliu-during-sinking-exercise)**：美海军GARC无人机艇在“击沉演习”中在旧“佩莱利乌”号上炸开大洞，标志无人系统实战化里程碑。

**后续观察**：乌克兰对伊朗船只的打击可能迫使伊朗在俄乌战场上更直接介入，而美伊暂停的背后是双方弹药库存的脆弱平衡。中国在台海与南海的联动行动表明其正同时应对多个战略方向。印太方向，无人武器从实验走向实战，RIMPAC成果将影响未来舰队设计。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic expansion of the war in Ukraine into the Caspian Sea, where a Ukrainian strike on an Iranian cargo vessel has directly linked the Russia-Ukraine and Iran-US proxy conflicts. Meanwhile, uneasy pauses in direct US-Iran fighting contrast with relentless Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, and China continues to assert its military presence in the South China Sea and across the Taiwan Strait. The following briefs distill the most consequential developments for defense professionals.

- **Ukraine's strike on an Iranian ship in the Caspian Sea marks a dangerous escalation**, merging two theaters of conflict. Reports indicate the attack killed several crew members and prompted Tehran to issue a formal warning to Kyiv. [Arab News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9WcDhOSWhQU1hOTEVoMUFYaWt0X0RIbnRYcml4a0xvREV0V1VFRVA3UjlFcHp2VFN6d1d1c2xmbkVDaV9ldWVyR1ZVYnAweEtRNTFJY1lQZkRGejNPZUE) | [The Defense Post](https://news.google.)
- **The White House has privately warned Ukraine against striking commercial shipping**, even as Russia continues attacks on Ukrainian port infrastructure. This contradiction highlights the growing friction between escalation management and strategic necessity. [Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE0zVWV1RUt5WWNFOE45MEtuRldCQ2NDUGtrRTRVNTZOYlVkeG1LMzZfeEFhaHZvSW9VOW01dW9Sc3RPVzBsQ3JtOWVuYw)
- **US-Iran direct fighting has paused**, but the Houthi campaign against Saudi oil facilities continues unabated, causing a slump in Bab el-Mandeb shipping. Interceptor stockpile concerns are mounting. [CNBC](https://news.google.) | [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uneasy-pause-in-u-s-iran-fighting-holds-amidst-growing-concerns-over-interceptor-stockpiles)
- **China continues to test its long-range strike capabilities**, reportedly using a new US warship as a target for missile tests, while also dispatching helicopters and UAVs across the Taiwan Strait median line for the first time simultaneously. [The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNbzZVbkNfVXhIa1hDeHF5b1FMOE1WQnVRY3BtTVhBRm1QT3ZSUkpkeUJ6MkhCSWFpVUI4a3dWV3NtRGN2T1pSZVFqc2l2MkNHOHBGR3BQdGxyUDZoQlhxTVJYaWtxdnkzR21mVnQ3eG8zVkp4TU85Z0FuaDhiTTBhWnJ4R1Z1c3BybTJiU0hwb0s) | [朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdkpDbEVHbWVtZFN2RXJFMGtCTnVYaUw3NVdwdWZTY0pFcEM5WUZoejZackNZSFJPeVhORkIzeEdFTmlla2Zvb0h0X0dnNERnSkhmLW1NRXdEZW9VblZaM1Zib01GTXRGM1o1OHJzZ09fRFVHZm5kd1NnSUJZYS1mQXdzWXRBOWs)
- **The US Navy's George Washington CSG is now operating in the South China Sea** following clashes between Philippine and Chinese forces, signaling increased deterrence posture. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/george-washington-csg-in-the-south-china-sea-after-philippine-chinese-clashes)
- **RIMPAC 2026 continues to showcase new capabilities**, including the Navy's GARC kamikaze drone boat sinking the ex-USS Peleliu, and the Australian Navy firing Naval Strike Missiles. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/navys-garc-kamikaze-drone-boat-blew-a-hole-in-ex-uss-peleliu-during-sinking-exercise) | [Zona Militar](https://news.google.)
- **NATO's Neptune Strike 26-3 wrapped up**, involving UK and Spanish carrier groups, while Austria announced plans to extend military service to nine months in response to the Ukraine war. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/u-k-spanish-navy-forces-wrap-natos-latest-neptune-strike-exercise) | [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/2026/07/27/austria-plans-to-extend-military-service-in-light-of-ukraine-war/)

**Watch next:** The Caspian Sea incident could trigger Iranian retaliation against Ukrainian interests, potentially widening the Iran-Israel-US proxy war into new domains. The White House's warning to Kyiv suggests a looming policy rift over maritime targeting. Meanwhile, Chinese cross-strait activity and South China Sea deployments will keep Indo-Pacific tensions high as RIMPAC concludes.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现出三条主线：AI 领域的模型安全与开源之争进入白热化，汽车市场的中美电动车竞争再升级，以及科技产品方面隐私泄露与平台生态的持续博弈。

- **AI 安全与隐私双响炮**：Claude 的共享聊天记录被 Google 和 Bing 索引 ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/private-claude-chats-exposed-in-google-and-bing-search-results/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/psa-your-claude-shared-chats-and-artifacts-may-have-ended-up-on-google/))，暴露了 AI 产品在 web 爬虫控制上的脆弱性。与此同时，OpenAI 模型在 Hugging Face 上“越狱”攻击事件 ([MIT Tech Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/27/1140836/openai-hugging-face-attack-precedent/)) 重新点燃了对齐与控制辩论。微软则发布了首个 AI 网络安全模型 MAI-Cyber-1-Flash ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-unveils-ai-security-tools-it-says-outperform-competing-platforms/))，试图抢占企业安全市场。
- **中国新能源车攻势**：比亚迪连续放出两款重磅电动车：旗舰轿车续航超 1000 公里 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/))，以及价格仅 Model 3 一半的 Seal 06 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-seal-06-ev-images-launch/))。同时比亚迪进军日本 Kei 车市场 ([Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxON21GSVVSUEJxQ2x0VjBfR3M3bzdpRXMxNTBfampwaUFuUVJpYWliRVhxM2kwUklQeG1Rc0wyMTNuODdkdGFtU0RiOFZIUFJCODFkb2V2dHpJdk9HNE5vdkVKUmZzU2hPMy1ISHVpVmFYdGlQaGhDNDkxT3NGZDZ3TFFuZ0k))，显示其全面出海野心。反观美国，Rivian R2 真实能耗高于 Model Y 达 26% ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/rivian-r2-tesla-model-y-real-world-efficiency-test/))，效率短板仍需补课。
- **科技产品的隐私与平台依赖**：X Money 在美有限上线，仅限 Premium 用户 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971649/x-money-launch-elon-musk), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2224633/x-money-begins-limited-us-rollout/))；Xbox 大宕机甚至连光盘游戏都无法运行 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/971545/xbox-outage-disc-physical-games))，凸显数字平台对实体娱乐的控制力。Starlink 获 FCC 豁免在越南生产路由器 ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/starlink-gets-exemption-from-fcc-ban-on-routers-made-outside-the-us/))，反映政治与供应链的张力。

**后续观察**：AI 模型的开放性正演变为国家安全议题，中国开源模型 Kimi K3 的成本优势已让硅谷紧张 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/971444/how-chinese-open-weight-ai-models-impact-us-companies))。汽车领域，300 英里续航已成为分水岭，而充电基础设施的餐饮场景绑定（如 Bojangles）则意味着“充电即消费”模式正在落地。苹果 iOS/macOS 26.6 的发布为秋季大更新铺路 ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/ios-and-macos-26-6-arrive-today-paving-the-way-for-ios-and-macos-27/))，但用户可能更关心隐私控制能否跟上。
tech.en:
The tech landscape today is dominated by escalating AI model wars (both US and China), significant EV product launches and charging infrastructure moves, and notable service outages affecting millions. The AI sector saw a major security breach at Claude, a new Microsoft cybersecurity model, and Anthropic’s CEO reigniting the open-weight debate. In automotive, BYD unveiled a 1,000 km flagship EV and a tiny kei car for Japan, while Mercedes launched the electric C-Class. X Money finally rolled out, but service reliability took hits with Xbox, Spotify, and Claude outages. On the infrastructure front, Meta pivoted to gas plants for AI data centers and Antares raised $470M for nuclear reactors for the US military.

- **Anthropic raises the bar with Claude Opus 5** as CEO Dario Amodei clarifies he doesn’t oppose open-weight models but fears Chinese AI ([Tekedia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPUlpiUTZjSnNzVzZVbUpDR0NKVHNvd1UzdDU1bWx1aGF1UG84NFlISTNlcTlyc2ZlWkQyZjRPVWl3V0JOZF9jLWxJTTIwMzNMNjF2YkRLVDdsVTdJVWdhY0p0NUI1cFNwQUNtV211VXJEclNNaWNMMnZJSnNaOTA0bUFkUy1EeDJ6SE1UN1BjRTA3ck05dzhNTmRZTEgtVk8xUm12VnJn), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/anthropics-dario-amodei-responds-doesnt-oppose-open-weight-models-but-fears-chinese-ai/)).
- **Microsoft enters the AI security arms race** with MAI-Cyber-1-Flash and a new agentic platform, claiming lower cost and higher performance than competitors ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-unveils-ai-security-tools-it-says-outperform-competing-platforms/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/microsoft-launches-its-first-cyber-model-and-a-new-agentic-cybersecurity-system/)).
- **BYD reveals a 1,008 km range flagship sedan** and targets Japan’s kei car market with a new tiny EV, intensifying pressure on legacy automakers ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/), [Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxON21GSVVSUEJxQ2x0VjBfR3M3bzdpRXMxNTBfampwaUFuUVJpYWliRVhxM2kwUklQeG1Rc0wyMTNuODdkdGFtU0RiOFZIUFJCODFkb2V2dHpJdk9HNE5vdkVKUmZzU2hPMy1ISHVpVmFYdGlQaGhDNDkxT3NGZDZ3TFFuZ0k)).
- **X Money launches in the US** — a digital wallet and metal Visa card for Premium subscribers, part of Musk’s “everything app” vision ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971649/x-money-launch-elon-musk), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2224633/x-money-begins-limited-us-rollout/)).
- **Claude’s private chats exposed in Google and Bing** due to a share-chat indexing flaw, raising questions about AI privacy controls ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/private-claude-chats-exposed-in-google-and-bing-search-results/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/psa-your-claude-shared-chats-and-artifacts-may-have-ended-up-on-google/)).
- **Meta quits RE100 and backs 10 gas plants** to power AI data centers, a stark reversal from its renewable energy pledges ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/meta-is-backing-10-gas-plants-and-just-quit-a-global-renewables-pledge/)).
- **Antares raises $470M for small nuclear reactors** destined for US Air Force bases, highlighting military interest in compact nuclear power ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/antares-raises-470m-to-build-nuclear-reactors-for-the-u-s-military/)).
- **Massive outages hit Xbox, Spotify, and Claude** — Xbox blocked disc-based games, Spotify had a second major outage, and Claude leaked private chats, underscoring reliability risks in digital services ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/971545/xbox-outage-disc-physical-games), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2224515/spotify-is-experiencing-another-major-outage/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/psa-your-claude-shared-chats-and-artifacts-may-have-ended-up-on-google/)).

**Watch next:** Look for regulatory fallout from Claude’s data leak and Microsoft’s new AI security model — plus the real-world efficiency battle between Rivian R2 and Tesla Model Y, which could sway EV buyer decisions.

sports.zh:
今日体育新闻焦点集中在夏季转会市场的连锁反应与国内联赛动态。足球方面，英格兰后卫斯通斯接近自由转会国际米兰，切尔西同时追逐亨德森与维尔贝克，英足总则针对门将拖延时间推出新规；篮球领域，CBA选秀落幕，台湾控卫宋昕澔当选状元，但外援流失问题引发反思；乒超联赛冷门频出，林诗栋缺阵导致上海地产首败；丁俊晖在上海大师赛上半场4-0领先。以下是关键动态：

- **斯通斯口头同意加盟国米**：据 [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cgewgj8qwvjo) 和 [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567544/john-stones-transfer-news-england-international-verbally-agrees-deal-to-join-inter-milan-amid-interest-from-arsenal-and-chelsea) 交叉证实，英格兰中卫约翰·斯通斯已与国米就自由转会达成口头协议，阿森纳和切尔西的竞争宣告失败。这笔交易将显著补强国米防线，但也反映出英超中卫薪资结构问题。

- **切尔西双线出击：亨德森+维尔贝克**：切尔西正在与布伦特福德谈判签下乔丹·亨德森，并向布莱顿前锋维尔贝克提出报价，旨在加强中场和锋线深度。此举或与斯通斯被截胡有关，切尔西需快速调整引援策略。

- **英足总试行“门将战术暂停”禁令**：英格兰足球将试点规则，禁止门将通过故意拖延时间获得战术暂停， [BBC分析](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyjxd53zkpo) 认为这将加快比赛节奏，但可能引发门将适应性问题。

- **CBA选秀：宋昕澔成状元**：广州龙狮用状元签选中台湾控卫宋昕澔，他此前与陈盈骏、陈国豪有过交流，认为CBA对抗强度极高。然而媒体人指出 [欧洲联赛合同稳定性与吸引力正超越CBA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPdVVJQ2NERmw3U0h3R3BKTnJMZmw0OEpmbEFOSElOeWFmekRUSHE2MU9mWjZTRXc0SmRueEwxWERuLVJsaUpGUFkyVmxlZHJZZnJzdnZqbWY2X0dIQ0h0al9EdUZFaU5EZVZNZjBlTUZjU2FjMlpwWEdOUGswYnRVWGFEb08)，CBA外援流失问题或将持续。

- **乒超男团：上海地产集团首败，山东魏桥六连胜**：林诗栋缺阵后，上海地产2-8不敌黄石东楚，遭遇赛季首败；山东魏桥8-2击败汕头明润，强势领跑。乒超格局出现松动。

- **丁俊晖上海大师赛4-0领先**：在24进16轮次中，丁俊晖上半场4-0碾压姚东成，展现出良好状态，但下半场能否守成仍需观察。

- **体育界暖闻：脑癌选手参加英联邦运动会**：英国选手阿奇·古德本在被诊断脑癌两年后，站上英联邦运动会决赛舞台，其故事激励无数人。

**后续观察**：斯通斯交易官宣时间、切尔西能否同时签下亨德森与维尔贝克、CBA各队对状元签的后续操作、以及乒超上海地产如何调整阵容将成为明日焦点。此外，羽毛球世锦赛临近，中国选手备战动态值得关注。
sports.en:
The sports world saw major transfer activity in football and basketball, while individual stories of resilience and controversy captured attention across disciplines. In football, England defender John Stones is poised for a shock free transfer to Inter Milan, and Chelsea are aggressively pursuing Jordan Henderson and Danny Welbeck. The CBA draft produced a headline-worthy No. 1 pick, and European basketball leagues continue to lure talent away from China. Community discussions buzzed over a table tennis upset, an official banned for stamping on a referee, and a snooker legend's retirement ultimatum. Meanwhile, the BWF World Championships approach with quiet anticipation.

- **Football transfer frenzy:** [John Stones verbally agrees Inter move](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567544/john-stones-transfer-news-england-international-verbally-agrees-deal-to-join-inter-milan-amid-interest-from-arsenal-and-chelsea) as advanced talks confirmed, while [Chelsea open talks to sign Henderson and Welbeck](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2d79ddvg4o), signaling a major squad rebuild.
- **CBA draft spotlight:** [The Guangzhou Loong Lions selected Taiwanese point guard Song Xinhao with the No. 1 pick](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1TRnFNLUpuR01QR28tTDNweFRnd2I0ZFpqTzR1LWMzcFptUXdaN0hZTHdfbVV5dkVNYll2M1VJcWVnT1BzSXZ0UkJmOUF0YjNkdHVEenZCQ1VmOURJWlljWUZ3TW9ZcWo1WV96NTlZWQ), adding a promising playmaker to the league.
- **Table tennis drama:** [Shanghai Dichi suffered their first loss in the men's CTTSL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFA2a0ZIMVZjeGRKZkU5djUtZ3hldEVkQk5UU1U4LWZVRFJrNmEyVWFtUlM2SmhGWEMxWE1EWENVTnIxbTFCdkJweUZNaHlsTEhNU3JIY0l4TGozY3Y2VnpBTE9RenZBN1NpaGpfZFZqM2ZYQQ) with Lin Shidong absent, while Shandong Weiqiao extended their winning streak to six.
- **Controversy in Chinese football:** [Dingnan Ganlian official Li Zhenbo was banned for 7 months](https://news.google.) for deliberately stamping on a referee's foot—a rare harsh penalty.
- **Snooker legend sets retirement deadline:** [Ronnie O'Sullivan gave himself until 2028 to win an 8th world title](https://www.skysports.com/snooker/news/12040/13567523/ronnie-osullivan-sets-2028-deadline-to-beat-stephen-hendry-record-of-seven-world-snooker-championship-titles), vowing to retire if he must play qualifying matches.
- **Resilience amid adversity:** [Swimmer Archie Goodburn competed in a Commonwealth Games final just two years after a brain cancer diagnosis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx2r823d77xo), offering a powerful human interest story.

**Watch next:** The Premier League season looms with key transfer decisions hanging—Stones' Inter move could trigger a domino effect at Manchester City, while Chelsea's pursuit of veteran midfielders suggests a short-term tactical shift. The BWF World Championships (dates TBC) will soon command global attention. Community forums will likely dissect the CBA draft's implications for domestic player development and the ongoing exodus of foreign talent to Europe.
