## 娱乐新闻板块简报（2026-07-28）

今日娱乐板块呈现多元热点：欧美市场被**《蜘蛛侠：新一天》洛杉矶首映**与**罗伯特·唐尼饰演毁灭博士**的漫威动态主导；日韩则迎来**iKON成员入伍**、**AAA颁奖礼阵容揭晓**及多部剧集收视变动；中国方面**东野圭吾版权落地近20部**与**首部AI长片上线**引发行业震荡；微博社区聚焦**宋亚轩胡茬自拍**、**迪丽热巴全名热搜**等话题。以下是各子区深度观察。

- [iKON’s Junhoe Announces Military Enlistment Date](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857924wpp/ikons-junhoe-announces-military-enlistment-date) — 继B.I、金振焕之后，iKON又一位成员服役，标志着二代/三代团集体进入“军白期”的延续。
- [2026 Asia Artist Awards (AAA) Announces First Artist Lineup](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857943wpp/2026-asia-artist-awards-aaa-announces-first-artist-lineup) — 由池昌旭与张员瑛主持，12月高雄国家体育场连办两晚，首批阵容引期待。
- [ZEROBASEONE’s Kim Ji Woong To Partially Sit Out Group Activities Due To Scheduling Conflicts](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857935wpp/zerobaseones-kim-ji-woong-to-partially-sit-out-group-activities-due-to-scheduling-conflicts) — 因演员行程缺席部分团体活动，包括SBS歌谣大庆，凸显偶像与演员身份平衡难题。
- [Tom Holland Says ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Is “More Mature”](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-mature-film-1237005340/) — 荷兰弟在首映式上透露第四部更黑暗成熟，与前作风格分岔。
- [Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Voice Gave ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Directors “Chills”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/robert-downey-jr-doctor-doom-voice-russo-brothers-chills-1236657698/) — RDJ首次为毁灭博士配音便令罗素兄弟震惊，漫威第五阶段反派塑造悬念升级。
- [Ariana Grande Sues Hackers for Leaking Unreleased Music and Footage](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/ariana-grande-sues-hackers-leaking-unreleased-music-footage-1236822277/) — 起诉匿名黑客泄露未发布曲目及录像，反映明星数字资产安全危机。
- [近20部版权落地中国 东野圭吾作品成国内影视“香饽饽”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9sMmdiNUpjLXRLcklmTFBtUFNETVBQZkk4X21UTTZFa1AwdnE0a3lMNFNXLWVuN0lmMmRTYzhBQi1HdTU1UUJVUU9xMHI5SU9yUkxxN1FSVjBLcWJXY2JJMV96c2EtdnktTm5iVmd5UFI) — 东野圭吾逝世后，中国手握近20部翻拍版权，但大量项目积压，“冰火两重天”态势明显。
- [中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺 开启AI影视规范化、产业化发展新阶段](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1zdmdKU3lnVURiLXpHYUhIMnJ6SVIxVTF2ZnZ4NHo4bW9vRjVyRFpqMndOb1ptaFhQUC1ScnNsUHc1ems1MWtKNkk4eVdieXYxOWlIZmJIMVVNUHp6VmI0UUFoU0tZdmhDTnZ0NVkwdEpHaXNCU010dA) — 国内首部AI长片《（片名未公开）》获得上线许可，标志AI影视从概念走向产业落地。
- [宋亚轩胡茬自拍上热搜！自嘲长痘反圈粉](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1HQzdLUXlLeGxzdWVMR1dYa3BzdFJ5NWYzaEtTNnJISlU0ckVQb25oQk0xbXd0UEhsdndqVi00NlM1Y0dSb3VDVG42MWNzbEFPTzJNZmJnWHlrY2JKRkVsdGx5OVFvLUZXV1lodmwyRHc) — 时代少年团成员宋亚轩发布胡茬素颜照，话题阅读量破亿，展现新生代偶像“去滤镜”沟通策略。

**后续观察**：东野圭吾IP在中国的影视化能否突破“囤版权”困局，将直接影响日本推理文学改编市场信心；AI长片上线对传统影视工业的冲击需关注观众接受度；《蜘蛛侠》系列风格转向和RDJ回归可能重塑漫威票房格局。
entertainment.en:
In the last 24 hours, the entertainment landscape has been dominated by major Hollywood premieres, K-pop enlistment news, and a surge of Chinese AI content production. The 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' premiere in Los Angeles drew significant attention with Zendaya's stunning spider-inspired fashion and Tom Holland's comments on the film's mature tone. Meanwhile, iKON's Junhoe announced his military enlistment, and ZEROBASEONE's Kim Ji Woong will partially sit out group activities due to scheduling conflicts. In China, the first AI-generated feature film obtained a distribution license, signaling a new phase for AI in the industry. The passing of author Higashino Keigo has also triggered a wave of adaptation interest and reflection on unused rights. Social media buzzed with celebrity name revelations and candid fan interactions.

- [iKON’s Junhoe Announces Military Enlistment Date](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857924wpp/ikons-junhoe-announces-military-enlistment-date) — The mandatory service impacts iKON's group activities, with fans bracing for a temporary hiatus.
- [ZEROBASEONE’s Kim Ji Woong To Partially Sit Out Group Activities Due To Scheduling Conflicts](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857935wpp/zerobaseones-kim-ji-woong-to-partially-sit-out-group-activities-due-to-scheduling-conflicts) — His acting schedule forces absence from some group events, including SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer.
- [Zendaya Stuns ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Premiere](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/zendaya-spider-man-brand-new-day-premiere-dress-law-roach-1236822294/) — The red carpet look and Tom Holland’s comments signal a darker, more mature chapter for the franchise.
- [Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Voice Gave ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Directors “Chills”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/robert-downey-jr-doctor-doom-voice-russo-brothers-chills-1236657698/) — The Russo brothers reveal the impact of Downey’s performance as the iconic villain.
- [Netflix Sets Launch Date for Lee Chang-dong’s Awards Hopeful ‘Possible Love’](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/netflix-lee-chang-dong-possible-love-release-date-1236657709/) — The acclaimed director's first film in eight years premieres at Venice before streaming globally.
- [中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺 开启AI影视规范化、产业化发展新阶段 — China's first AI feature film gets a license on iQiyi, marking a milestone for AI in filmmaking and sparking debate on traditional industry impact.
- [近20部版权落地中国 东野圭吾作品成国内影视“香饽饽” — Nearly 20 Higashino Keigo works have their rights sold in China, but many remain unused, highlighting a gap between acquisition and production.
- [迪丽热巴全名为何突然登上热搜？ — Fans debate the spelling of Dilraba Dilmurat's full name, showing the power of celebrity name trivia on Weibo.

Watch next: The 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' box office performance and audience reception will be critical, while the Chinese AI film rollout could set regulatory precedents. The Higashino Keigo adaptation pipeline may see accelerated production as rights holders face pressure to capitalize.

美股.zh:
美股周二（盘前）受芯片股暴跌拖累，但油价回落提供了部分对冲。苹果市值正式超越英伟达，反映市场风格切换。特朗普公开施压美联储降息，而Kalshi平台押注Warsh本周讲话将提及“供应冲击”。关键线索：
- [SK Hynix暴跌13%，芯片股抛售蔓延至美股](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/skhynix-plunges-semiconductor-selloff-deepens-samsung-softbank.html)，Kospi和纳指相关性升至0.5。
- [油价跌超2%，因美伊冲突暂停](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/oil-price-today-wti-brent-us-iran-hormuz.html)，布伦特降至88美元以下，缓解通胀压力。
- [苹果终结英伟达的市值冠军地位](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/apple-most-valuable-company-nvidia.html)，自2025年6月以来首次易主。
- [SpaceX市值已蒸发相当于一个特斯拉](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/spacex-has-now-lost-the-equivalent-of-a-full-tesla-in-market-capitalization.html)，高位回撤超1.2万亿美元。
- 总体看，市场正从“AI基建”主题转向“避险+消费”，美联储政策与地缘风险仍是短期波动源。
美股.en:
U.S. equity markets are under pressure from a deepening semiconductor sell-off that began in Asia. Apple reclaimed the title of world's most valuable company as Nvidia lost over $1 trillion in market cap since June. Oil's sharp decline is providing some relief, but the Fed's messaging later this week will be critical for rate-sensitive sectors.

- [SK Hynix shares plunge 13% in Seoul as chip sell-off deepens](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/sk-hynix-plunges-semiconductor-selloff-deepens-samsung-softbank.html) — The rout in South Korean chipmakers has direct implications for U.S. semiconductor ETFs and holders of Samsung and SK Hynix ADRs.
- [Apple ends day as world's most valuable company, passing Nvidia](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/apple-most-valuable-company-nvidia.html) — Nvidia's 60% peak-to-trough decline signals waning AI euphoria; Apple's relative stability highlights rotation to quality.
- [Oil prices drop more than 2% as a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities raises de-escalation hopes](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/28/oil-price-today-wti-brent-us-iran-hormuz.html) — A sustained decline in crude could dampen inflationary pressure and support consumer discretionary stocks.
- [Trump backs 'fantastic' Warsh while calling for lower rates](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/trump-warsh-interest-rates.html) — Political pressure on the Fed to cut rates conflicts with the need to manage supply-side inflation from oil.

Signal: The Kospi-Nasdaq correlation at 0.50 suggests any further weakness in Korean memory stocks will directly weigh on U.S. tech indexes.

中国经济.zh:
A股遭遇科技股杀跌，创业板指大跌5.37%，AI硬件方向领跌；但CXMT上市首日暴涨466%，创下A股市值纪录，凸显资金对国产芯片的极端追捧。港股则因科技巨头利好小幅上涨。
- [A股午评：创业板指跌5.37%，AI硬件大幅领跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE91WnI1eUhrNVpSVFBJcWFVT0tJN0pSQ0Exck04QlR6Q2VTZlh2UjlhaDk3LUN6THRxLWc3YXRWOGF6VVRMa1R4Znk0R0trYXpVdkVkRmVnVTI0bzFZN2c)，兆易创新、东山精密触及跌停。
- [CXMT首日涨466%，市值超工商银行](https://www.scmp.com/plus/tech/big-tech/article/3361997/cxmt-surge-shows-why-china-stock-buyers-see-ipos-one-way-bet)，成为A股市值最大公司，但全球DRAM股下跌。
- [Michael Burry增加AI空头仓位](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361950/big-short-trader-michael-burrys-rising-bearish-ai-positions-test-chinas-stock-support)，对Nvidia、Micron等押注，可能挑战中国市场支撑。
- [LVMH时尚部门Q2有机增长1%](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362057/lvmhs-fashion-and-leather-division-reports-1-organic-growth-second-quarter)，7个季度以来首次正增长，奢侈品需求边际回暖。
- 短期需关注CXMT后续走势是否引发资金虹吸效应，以及国家资金是否入场护盘。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets experienced a dramatic split: A-share tech stocks plunged, with the ChiNext down 5.37%, while CXMT's blockbuster IPO created a $460 billion company overnight. The government is attempting to support the market, but bearish bets from Michael Burry and Moody's warnings on hyperscaler debt are dampening sentiment. Hong Kong saw a more positive tone.

- [A股午评：创业板指低开低走跌5.37% AI硬件方向大幅领跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE91WnI1eUhrNVpSVFBJcWFVT0tJN0pSQ0Exck04QlR6Q2VTZlh2UjlhaDk3LUN6THRxLWc3YXRWOGF6VVRMa1R4Znk0R0trYXpVdkVkRmVnVTI0bzFZN2c) — AI hardware names like GigaDevice and Dongshan Precision hit limit-down, reflecting contagion from the global chip rout.
- [China's CXMT Surges 466% After IPO, Micron Stock, Other Memory Plays Slip](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNMGNUZ3dQYU9zU1I3VDhWN1pMUGRTeUdxTXY5aVZJcmo4Nzc5QUpldnU3VS1xR0Q0X3RtOTJzOWZfb2Jtd0I2Qmt5bFE2UE5kcVNnSGhCQ0JuUXI5RUtoWlFOM2dfQ0F4MmotVXgzRi04MzVlWHg4akpZZ3hsWGFIU0dtUE9qR1J0dlE) — CXMT's 466% surge makes it China's largest company by market cap; the stock now trades at 5.7x its IPO price, raising valuation concerns.
- [Big Short trader Michael Burry's rising bearish AI positions test China's stock support](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361950/big-short-trader-michael-burrys-rising-bearish-ai-positions-test-chinas-stock-support) — Burry's shorts against Nvidia and Micron indicate skepticism about AI capex sustainability, which could spill over to Chinese AI-linked names.
- [Hong Kong stocks rise on positive news of tech, online travel giants](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxObURma25JOUVJeVRTZ3JjT2c1QXFjZGxTMk9TNFFSQ2dqV0REdDBTRmhlQVVDMHVfM2FqTkNHVnJicEZYbS1RUk16S202ME93ZmdkZWNfX3pielZKeWxDN2lJR3FqWjJweWVOT3VjT2xtVmlOVVFGMV9lc2ZPdmpGVGxBZ1dCYlY1NGh1cmgxd19oNUtHSHNvUFU3dktodWx2Yno1ZnFPLTRzcU9lMnpnRzlvUTUwM2N2TlM1eGxTejBLb3pEeGc) — Hong Kong's Hang Seng managed gains, led by Alibaba and Trip.com, suggesting capital is rotating toward consumer/internet names.

Signal: The CXMT IPO mania is a one-way bet that could reverse sharply if global chip sentiment worsens; watch for regulatory intervention if the stock continues to surge.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲股市周一收高，主要受益于油价大幅下跌缓解能源压力。但ECB官员继续释放鹰派信号，暗示9月可能加息。同时，阿斯利康CEO警告西方制药业需以“中国速度”创新。
- [欧洲股市因油价下跌收高](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/27/oil-prices-fall-us-strikes-iran-brent-crude-bp-shell-ftse-100)，布伦特原油跌至88美元以下，英国国债收益率下行。
- [ECB委员Kazimir：9月加息可能仍必要](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOWTZQYWhqU3duUVJfbGppeGtlTFpmYTNmNjBnZTk2dzY4TkxKaFRBd2NocmgzUTQ5a3Axa3FGYS1yVS1FWmJkd1JaaUZISTFFWWl5Z2xGTU8xTXp1bDcwTmlhTGVscVFxZ2lJaGFxSDI1QjJVaEVYa0ZkTjlJbkR6cVhXc1BWTHJHVVRjY2RuTzMxMk1SbzRERlBQMG55UGtwWlhEY2Z5LXFSbGJpX3lKaTNTTnppS28)，即便经济前景改善。
- [欧洲经济处于关键节点：衰退风险因能源通胀上升](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQWGN6dnRNTHVXTVZTblBXVEhIaDZXY2FLVi1PN25xSFBEOUR6VUNiUWE2Zk52dWtUakYyeE9tVDE3eHpBUmpMaGJ6MGlXYlRvZnVMRWpLQVBDNFNsaFRiMl9GcjZQNkplTjVDcjRPOUdzOVZ1dUFmalRqenZXbVhlOENVNFVxUHpKOWxUaUVHMFhDemZfZ25FVnFaNUUweC1McWJ4RzhLZUd2dFVld2c)，油价下跌或为暂时喘息。
- [阿斯利康CEO呼吁以“中国速度”创新](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/27/astrazeneca-boss-urges-western-drugmakers-to-move-at-chinese-speed)，避免重蹈汽车业覆辙。
- 当前欧洲市场情绪改善主要依赖油价回落，但ECB紧缩和地缘不确定性仍是中期风险。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets ended higher on Monday as a sharp drop in oil prices boosted risk appetite. The STOXX 600 rose across the board, with transport and consumer sectors leading. The ECB struck a hawkish tone, with officials signaling a September rate hike remains probable despite improving outlook, keeping bond markets on edge.

- [European stocks close higher as US-Iran tensions ease](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxObVVRR2N0XzVGanhuVnFJaFZKb2JqMGZxOGw0Y1ZOTFdPekJwY2RJRFJuR0FldjA5dmNNa2ZOMktweVdiNlJXb2FNVVIzZVA3bE92Wkx6N1REWTNRYVlEbzBob3pTZFFtb0ZEMlIwOUNHcV9IZmhoeU5JRGRBVGY2bEh2LThtMzZHdmJmUDcwRi1fbUdQMWYxWi13) — The 9% drop in Brent crude provided a tailwind for net energy importers like airlines and chemicals.
- [ECB's Kazimir: September rate hike likely needed even if outlook improves](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOWTZQYWhqU3duUVJfbGppeGtlTFpmYTNmNjBnZTk2dzY4TkxKaFRBd2NocmgzUTQ5a3Axa3FGYS1yVS1FWmJkd1JaaUZISTFFWWl5Z2xGTU8xTXp1bDcwTmlhTGVscVFxZ2lJaGFxSDI1QjJVaEVYa0ZkTjlJbkR6cVhXc1BWTHJHVVRjY2RuTzMxMk1SbzRERlBQMG55UGtwWlhEY2Z5LXFSbGJpX3lKaTNTTnppS28) — A hawkish ECB adds to rate-sensitive sectors' headwinds; real estate and utilities may underperform.
- [Europe's Economy at Critical Juncture: Recession Risk Rises Amid Energy Inflation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQWGN6dnRNTHVXTVZTblBXVEhIaDZXY2FLVi1PN25xSFBEOUR6VUNiUWE2Zk52dWtUakYyeE9tVDE3eHpBUmpMaGJ6MGlXYlRvZnVMRWpLQVBDNFNsaFRiMl9GcjZQNkplTjVDcjRPOUdzOVZ1dUFmalRqenZXVjhlOENVNFVxUHpKOWxUaUVHMFhDemZfZ25FVnFaNUUweC1McWJ4RzhLZUd2dFVld2c) — While oil's fall offers short-term relief, structural inflation from energy transition and tariffs persists.
- [LVMH's fashion and leather division reports 1% organic growth in second quarter](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362057/lvmhs-fashion-and-leather-division-reports-1-organic-growth-second-quarter) — Luxury sector stabilization, especially in China, is a positive signal for European consumer discretionary.

Signal: The interplay between ECB hawkishness and falling energy costs will define European risk premiums in the near term; a softer oil price may allow the ECB to pause earlier than currently signaled.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
今日同花顺社区情绪冰火两重天：创业板暴跌5.37%引发恐慌，AI硬件龙头触及跌停；但新材料ETF逆市上涨，个别个股走出6连板。融资盘活跃，中际旭创获融资买入40.89亿元居首。
- [A股午评：创业板指跌5.37%，AI硬件大领跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE91WnI1eUhrNVpSVFBJcWFVT0tJN0pSQ0Exck04QlR6Q2VTZlh2UjlhaDk3LUN6THRxLWc3YXRWOGF6VVRMa1R4Znk0R0trYXpVdkVkRmVnVTI0bzFZN2c)，市场恐慌情绪蔓延。
- [兆易创新、东山精密触及跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1iNlpoQmZ5bE1lTGdIUTJvQS00LXhCR2lIMm41OXhpdVVraldtbVZYSk5pU1VFME13VWwydDI1bjY4OVhWMGZSb2RoYjBhdTd1YU9wbWJVd1htcDdWdmNEY253)，市值超6000亿的AI硬件龙头遭遇抛售。
- [603221连续6涨停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9qVGdJTjVURVZUaUtNb0FHVVJGMWl5V0JrZGNubEFwUmxyMXNMdllkY1RMTF9Hd2piTUNSOFkzYVpFLUxWNlZmeHNfRFpwX2pMdXN3Wm9QTGUtOUIwNGtBOXpn)，逆市拉升显示游资抱团。
- [新材料ETF领涨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5fTnp4Z3Zja2piLUdvUWQ3OTM3djU3N2dia3ZDSEtkU2otSTV5XzhGdmtacElhRnhYazVfaVhQTVIyOEgySDE2czlQc2xOUWlfTVdxSC1MTGZZWTlVZWJ6aG1B)，AI浪潮带动材料需求预期，资金切换至防御性题材。
- 社区讨论焦点已从AI算力转向国产替代与材料安全，短期需警惕高位连板股的技术回调风险。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Retail investor sentiment in China turned sharply bearish as AI hardware stocks collapsed, dragging down the broader market. The ChiNext index fell 5.37%, with heavyweights like GigaDevice (兆易创新, 270bn market cap) and Dongshan Precision (东山精密, 350bn) hitting limit-down. However, some defensive plays and special situation stocks saw extreme buying, with a share code 603221 locking its sixth consecutive daily limit up. ETF flows showed broad-based fund inflows.

- [2700亿市值兆易创新、3500亿东山精密，触及跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1iNlpoQmZ5bE1lTGdIUTJvQS00LXhCR2lIMm41OXhpdVVraldtbVZYSk5pU1VFME13VWwydDI1bjY4OVhWMGZSb2RoYjBhdTd1YU9wbWJVd1htcDdWdmNEY253) — Two of China's largest semiconductor and electronics manufacturing firms hit limit-down, signaling panic in AI supply chain names.
- [逆市拉升！603221，连续6涨停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9qVGdJTjVURVZUaUtNb0FHVVJGMWl5V0JrZGNubEFwUmxyMXNMdllkY1RMTF9Hd2piTUNSOFkzYVpFLUxWNlZmeHNfRFpwX2pMdXN3Wm9QTGUtOUIwNGtBOXpn) — A mystery stock (603221) continues its relentless rally, attracting retail speculators who are rotating out of AI names.
- [昨日宽基型ETF整体净流入160.08亿元 多只债券型ETF资金净流出](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1WR0hSR1FINnBWbk5IZzA5MWJkMlBRNU42OEFQbFlQWDZrZXZHM2VlUkxPdUJnaFkxbnEwTnBFa2wzZGNGSFBjRkxqUl81UnZ5bV9FanctdndUVVI3eWc) — Broad-based equity ETFs saw massive net inflows of 16 billion yuan, while bond ETFs saw outflows, suggesting retail investors are 'buying the dip' in index funds.
- [7月27日277股获融资买入超亿元 中际旭创获买入40.89亿元居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5uTDJGX3JQQUF3bWVnSVJOVXZxQ2ppdlhiWnNldGRaejAyVl80RTRLcTVGTERTOGVUSXN0Q3U3VC1kSzAzYm9mWlBhWWJaMGVQWnR3N0o2QTVZZUFobmc) — Despite the sell-off, leveraged margin buying remained active, with Zhongji Innolight (an optical module maker) seeing 4 billion yuan in margin purchases, indicating some traders see a buying opportunity.

Signal: The divergence between ETF inflows and individual stock limit-downs suggests a market at a crossroads: retail investors are hedging through indexes but piling into speculative names, a pattern that often precedes increased volatility.

欧美.zh:
**欧美小专栏：战争、火灾与历史清算并行**

美伊博弈进入“喊话阶段”：伊朗否认直接谈判，但特朗普暗示“有机会发生”，与此同时乌克兰对伊朗船只的袭击迫使美国参议院加速对俄制裁表决。法国波尔多大火逼近市区，30万人撤离，当地人称“从未想象过这样的火墙”。智利终于抓获1973年杀害民谣歌手维克多·哈拉的凶手，近半世纪后正义迟到但未缺席。

- **美伊战争边缘的“谈判暂停”**：特朗普称“在空袭暂停期间谈判进行中”，伊朗外长则威胁“不能没有回应”。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62xn4vzmnpo) 与 [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/28/trump-says-iran-talks-taking-place-during-pause-in-us-military-strikes) 相互印证，但伊朗官方渠道否认直接接触，显示双方仍在进行舆论试探。
- **乌克兰-伊朗-美国三角联动**：乌克兰攻击伊朗船只，伊朗扬言报复，泽连斯基赴美与特朗普会面，同时参议院将投票制裁俄罗斯。[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/28/ukraines-zelenskyy-set-to-meet-trump-as-iran-and-ukraine-wars-converge) 指出两场战争正“汇聚”，可能塑造新的对抗轴心。
- **法国山火成灾难标本**：距波尔多9英里，市长称“准备更多疏散”，目击者描述“火焰之墙”。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly5qwwdvr1o) 收集的证词显示民众对气候风险感知正在发生质变。
- **智利历史罪行终结**：Nelson Haase在逃亡多年后被捕，他曾参与1973年军事政变后杀害歌手Víctor Jara。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3w0xwj8vzyo) 的报道象征性地关上了一扇通往皮诺切特黑暗时代的门。

**收束判断**：欧美社会新闻的底层逻辑正从“单一议题”转向“共振”——战争、气候、历史正义三条线同时加速，且彼此传染风险（如伊朗局势可能引爆能源价格并冲击欧洲山火救援资源配置）。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran conflict dominates the European desk, with a high-stakes diplomatic pause that could either de-escalate or lead to a broader war. Ukraine's direct involvement further complicates the picture. Separately, a major wildfire threatens Bordeaux, France, and a Chilean fugitive from the Pinochet era was captured. The recent shooting at the US consulate in Toronto raises security concerns.

- **Trump confirms Iran talks but Iran denies direct negotiations.** A pause in US strikes provides a potential off-ramp, but the situation remains volatile as Ukraine's Zelenskyy prepares to meet Trump ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62xn4vzmnpo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/28/ukraines-zelenskyy-set-to-meet-trump-as-iran-and-ukraine-wars-converge)). The convergence of the Ukraine and Iran conflicts is unprecedented.
- **Ukraine strikes Iranian vessel in Caspian Sea, Iran vows response.** Tehran's foreign minister says the attack 'cannot go unanswered,' linking two war theaters directly ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyj7yl0xndo)).
- **France wildfire forces 300,000 to evacuate; Bordeaux under threat.** The mayor warns the fire is nine miles from the city, calling it 'catastrophic.' Witnesses describe a 'wall of flames' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg34128nvpo), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly5qwwdvr1o)).
- **Chile captures fugitive convicted in Victor Jara murder under Pinochet.** Nelson Haase was finally apprehended decades after the 1973 crime, a symbolic move for human rights justice ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3w0xwj8vzyo)).
- **Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for second time this year.** Suspect remains at large after high-speed chase; similar incident in June led to arrests ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckgvnw44rz9o)).

The dominant theme is the intertwining of multiple crises—war, fire, and historical justice—demanding close monitoring of diplomatic outcomes and climate-driven disasters.

日韩.zh:
**日韩小专栏：市场恐慌、历史伤痕与AI伦理**

韩国与日本股市领跌亚洲科技板块，SK海力士跌破美股发行价，市场对中美芯片竞争外溢的恐惧压倒一切。在政治层面，韩国前总统因选举虚假信息被判有罪，日本首相Takaichi在立法胜利后面临公众信任考验。技术伦理方面，首尔部署AI摄像头识别自杀行为，而Meta被曝投放来自中国的“AI脱衣”广告。

- **芯片恐慌蔓延**：韩国与东京股市同步暴跌，SK海力士股价跌破美国存托股发行价。[France 24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOVkVMTDZROUpyamw4Z0xKOTdPUEVtRG5lSERpdk9DT1RYU1JrUV84NTdvNDFZQzlSWHpMUEplRVRFSnRqa1pIVnZlWHVwV3RQUHRVVmtlMnpjbmVuSGowOHAxSjVkUFo5Uml3UDg5Q0NpTFR4ajlfY20tQlVZUXluUmk3eEFOaXZHaEJzeFFFZ3BFMXFsbzU0aHpQcDlhbFdOWFQ2MXgzVmcteVdNc2c) 表示这是“科技股最新一轮溃败”的一部分，中国市场竞争力被投资者视为关键风险。
- **韩国前总统李明博？**（原文为“ex-president found guilty of election disinformation”），[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPRE55Z1h3OTZXM1M4X3g0clFBUGdkMGdFeDQwZ0k0WkdKZGZCTFpJVFNtbEJTSTU2WVhnU0dLWUppdUd2Uk9CMk5qcE1oV0hqbkhfcGNZaHFDU0h5NThjZTNQRTZ4OEJZa1Ntb1M2MG4wTnYzdkUyamVwdG9Cc3piXzdHVkNxREFuekVUZDhvSnlRdVBnSGhLcFFudkFOWGF0YmMtNm9xV2I) 报道，这标志着韩国司法系统对高层政治人物的持续追溯，可能加剧朝野对立。
- **AI摄像头救自杀**：首尔部署AI监控系统，实时识别试图自杀者。[The Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNdmNrYU9YS09lNGFJN29nUHhKQmhEWHNPRWNUdlJ0X1BIS3d3c09Nd29jNVl1NVNILVQ5ZVlaY3pFVjkxLUxIV1llRXQxYXF2ekRMdERKN2Utc2I3VXpfQ1RGSUt1aUtlRmhvRjlrNU5aRjJWYWlTMlllc0tJamRkdXhRaWxXWE5qdTJHUWhkZVhTVWxvV3pPVy1Hd2FwX01qZWc) 指出技术干预的伦理争议——在“拯救生命”与“隐私侵入”之间如何平衡？
- **Meta的AI广告丑闻**：Instagram和Facebook被指投放来自中国的“AI脱衣”广告，[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNR3N4b0x4TWxkbWliWVhlVWY4azZyYmphcnBsbS01YXg2OVJvS1pNdHVuX01iZUI1RGpIWDcwZ1hoU2Y5U1Fsc1c2WGRjM1ZXTDF1ZVhkNHJwcTdNQVF4Wk04cGhLaG0zWjhQblhJRkNEdzZTTGlfSjNEMW5rOS1JQmRJTjZ2TVBMTUxSNnl3YUdVNGFpZUcyZg) 报道此事，这凸显AI生成内容监管上的跨国灰色地带。

**收束判断**：日韩双线承压——外部是中美科技脱钩引发的市场恐慌，内部是历史遗留问题与新技术伦理的叠加震荡。AI摄像头与AI色情广告几乎同步出现，显示该地区对AI的拥抱与担忧并存。
日韩.en:
The Japan-Korea desk is marked by economic and diplomatic tensions: a tech stock rout led by Korean chipmakers, a new demand from Seoul for Japan to address forced labor history, and domestic political shifts in both countries. Mental health and AI-driven social measures also feature prominently.

- **Korean chip stocks plummet; SK Hynix falls below US listing price.** The sell-off, driven by China competition fears, dragged down Seoul and Tokyo markets ([France 24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOVkVMTDZROUpyamw4Z0xKOTdPUEVtRG5lSERpdk9DT1RYU1JrUV84NTdvNDFZQzlSWHpMUEplRVRFSnRqa1pIVnZlWHVwV3RQUHRVVmtlMnpjbmVuSGowOHAxSjVkUFo5Uml3UDg5Q0NpTFR4ajlfY20tQlVZUXluUmk3eEFOaXZHaEJzeFFFZ3BFMXFsbzU0aHpQcDlhbFdOWFQ2MXgzVmcteVdNc2c)). This has significant implications for the global semiconductor supply chain.
- **South Korea demands Japan reflect forced labor at heritage sites.** Seoul is escalating historical grievances ahead of possible UNESCO discussions ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPVDYwQ0Y2c0xjQm1Ya3ZWMXVNQWVUeG9PZjdvZEVVdXBWcUJMMldyY1lUTjJsXzM2ZmVaVHRSMkw4TXpCeHJLNDN0M1U4VVNXZS1uS2Z1ZGNVeGhBdTFwamRKWXdhMlFiUlZGc2d1S1JBMjBmOXlXVDBDRG96OWJScTA0d3NZaWdyX01ZVg)).
- **Japan PM defends LDP-JIP coalition amid public concern over foreign workers.** As Japan relies on foreign labor, the PM acknowledges public unease while maintaining coalition ties ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQYkl3ZEFSbkx1Zm11aGdadVMyX202bzJndnYxaHd2b1FOcFhFY0hQVFJmeURhWEJMMUl2c1R3S09ONjhpWVY0RnlEOGR0RU5mVWt0VDlUMU9VX2JoWkZiSUhfYkpnSWFZenA3TjUwcjBBTFpXT1h0c09lWW5qTHlDTnhsUVRjRlJ4cEUzRg)).
- **AI-powered cameras detect suicide attempts in Seoul.** The technology is being used proactively in public spaces, raising ethical questions about privacy and surveillance ([Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNdmNrYU9YS09lNGFJN29nUHhKQmhEWHNPRWNUdlJ0X1BIS3d3c09Nd29jNVl1NVNILVQ5ZVlaY3pFVjkxLUxIV1llRXQxYXF2ekRMdERKN2Utc2I3VXpfQ1RGSUt1aUtlRmhvRjlrNU5aRjJWYWlTMlllc0tJamRkdXhRaWxXWE5qdTJHUWhkZVhTVWxvV3pPVy1Hd2FwX01qZWc)).
- **South Korea and Japan rank lowest in global mental health survey.** This finding aligns with high suicide rates and intense social pressures in both societies ([Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNZndzQUZOVE5vNzdEX0I1dUx3bmYwTXRHbXFzWC1zVlBPenhBSWNmNUhuSTZ3Z3JQRUk2U29jbWM1TV80QzFsRS1ZZFpKYVdaVkFmYjNKNUg0NzM1eGdjZjVnVXY4UWR2NjNZalBOU3UtelRkNjlwOHcyTTRhQUV1VDFtWXFPeGRsd2lULTBqTkdnWnU5MmtVRTlCTDk)).

The confluence of economic weakness, historical disputes, and social pressures makes the Japan-Korea axis a critical region to watch for both market volatility and policy shifts.

知乎社区动态.zh:
**知乎社区动态：热钱、假链接与知识社区转型**

过去24小时知乎社区的公开信息流出现明显分割：一方面是资本面信号（长鑫科技上市暴增、知乎回购），另一方面是大量低质甚至恶意内容（伪造政府域名传播成人链接）以及娱乐八卦（陈飞宇张子枫新片）。知乎人文季活动则呈现平台试图向“创作+科技”方向引导的努力。

- **长鑫科技上市震惊A股**：涨幅达472%，成为A股市值王，同时Hugging Face向OpenAI索赔1亿美元算力。[TechFlow情报局](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE1UcWczeDJsY0JGajJFcGNUcElKM19pcGpicVI0SmhQMmJFYlRmV3lkaUZVUUtzaDlNeWpKZjBZZVZXeU9oOWxFMndJMFR3RUdrblJfYw) 这一消息在知乎引发讨论，呼应了用户对芯片自主和AI算力战争的关切。
- **虚假政府网站泛滥**：多个以“福建省人民政府”域名出现的成人内容链接（如“羽月希与黑人BD在线”）通过RSS源混入，[该条目](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQdHJ5UHJBdFNsbXEySXZmQ3huTVQ1LXJrbzU3VEhibk9XMUJPdWpwVDRjNkdEcHVmamRsbUZRcTFmalU5RmZ1ZTJmalNrY3dvTFYyd1kyVmNyTURuMERRaVpBUFJRM3d0UkRHQVRZd1Z4MU90VmRfR0lnY0VVQ2VITWlUU0Qyd1RvMGpyNFZrWmF5SEktVUxmMVdobVRoZktRQUR3NUZoUGlwUQ) 显示社交媒体信息聚合的审核漏洞值得关注。
- **知乎人文季：手搓与Vibe Coding**：平台倡导“科技注入人文巧思”，鼓励用户手工制作与编程创意作品。[砍柴网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1QY0htLWxidk9MTllHS09Dei1tcWp4V21TM05KQWZYVHRZRkVhNXNPd2NwQ2Nock5SUEotbkZoS2wwVExJWmlEUFJGWENMcWZDMW5DcUxWNHRtTEtT) 报道展示该活动在知识社区中形成的反差——一边是严肃议题，一边是轻娱乐内容。
- **知乎回购与资本动作**：知乎-W于7月24日斥资13.9万美元回购13.16万股，[新浪财经](https://news.google.) 这一举动在市场波动中传递管理层对估值低估的判断。

**收束判断**：知乎社区正在经历内容净化与商业化的拉锯——人文季的“正能量”创作与虚假政府链接的混入形成尖锐对比。平台若不加强对RSS聚合源的审核，品牌信任将持续受损。
知乎社区动态.en:
The Zhihu community feed is mixed: it includes substantive tech/finance content alongside spam and entertainment. The most notable items are the massive IPO of ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) surging 472%, a legal claim by Hugging Face against OpenAI for $100 million in compute costs, and Zhihu's share buyback. However, many entries are non-news or suspicious links (e.g., adult content disguised as government pages).

- **ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) soars 472% on IPO, becoming A-share market cap leader.** This reflects China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency and investor enthusiasm for domestic chipmakers ([TechFlow](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE1UcWczeDJsY0JGajJFcGNUcElKM19pcGpicVI0SmhQMmJFYlRmV3lkaUZVUUtzaDlNeWpKZjBZZVZXeU9oOWxFMndJMFR3RUdrblJfYw)).
- **Hugging Face sues OpenAI for $100 million over alleged compute resource violations.** This case could set a precedent for AI infrastructure disputes and competition ([TechFlow](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE1UcWczeDJsY0JGajJFcGNUcElKM19pcGpicVI0SmhQMmJFYlRmV3lkaUZVUUtzaDlNeWpKZjBZZVZXeU9oOWxFMndJMFR3RUdrblJfYw)).
- **Zhihu repurchases 131,600 shares for $139,000 on July 24.** A small buyback, signaling management's view of undervaluation ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.)).
- **2026 Zhihu Humanities Festival: 'Handcrafted and Vibe Coding' creations showcased.** A community event blending technology and humanities, indicating platform engagement ([Kanchai Wang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1QY0htLWxidk9MTllHS09Dei1tcWp4V21TM05KQWZYVHRZRkVhNXNPd2NwQ2Nock5SUEotbkZoS2wwVExJWmlEUFJGWENMcWZDMW5DcUxWNHRtTEtT)).

While the desk contains noise, the CXMT IPO and Hugging Face lawsuit are significant signals in the AI and semiconductor sectors. The prevalence of spam links suggests need for content moderation attention.

中国.zh:
**中国小专栏：减税民生、申遗成功与治理现代化**

中国社会领域过去24小时的消息以政策落地与文化自信为主调：上半年1.26亿人享受个税专项附加扣除，减税超3200亿元；景德镇手工瓷业遗存申遗成功，外交部就此表态；正阳门城楼恢复开放，中轴线文化地标再添活力。同时，有关部门继续推进消防安全、普法规划等基础治理工作，并查处冒充人大教授的个案。

- **大规模减税显现效应**：上半年1.26亿人享受养老、医疗等专项附加扣除，减税超3200亿元。[中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9BdUVaVTZYQlVkbUUzZHREbm44dGNYRzVCUXdqQi1wMnlJMzRDR3pQdmZuYnR4a2p0aHZCSmNvQjQ2aTBlQ0pITzVsblRuemMzQml3YVA0OVkxZzRuN0R0WXVLLTV1aWtacnc) 这不仅是经济数据，更反映政策向老龄化与医疗保障倾斜的意图。
- **景德镇申遗成功**：外交部介绍，景德镇手工瓷业遗存列入世界遗产，标志着中国陶瓷文化国际认可的新高度。[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5CbW1GZ0hjSDJ0cjRPcVlRWUhFWGt5WFJPUE5wZGZxV3h3ZTAyS09Jd1dQTjYxdi05Z1RhWHA3ajlXbklLZXhqSVZxRm56X2tab09MQUxhei1xNXRIa25XaEJnaUpVTXN6Z3lFcC0wb3dBbWFOaFotRVA2UTVrdw) 此事件在文化自信叙事中占据重要位置。
- **正阳门城楼重开**：北京中轴线上的正阳门城楼恢复向社会开放，[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1jTTBVYVZoOHE3T1Uxd0tEcWlXZHhicndtOTRMa3gtQ0Nkd1gzMV9Sd01xVEdPUWxQTnI2RHR4NlRyb19EX1g0UGJZQl8yT3NxakFTTENwa2V1TGxUbTR3S195U05ySWNPY1ZqQmtjUmxUZFJiT0tENGNjelpTZw) 提及这是中轴线申遗成功后进一步的活化利用。
- **社会人士冒充人大教授**：涉事学院澄清并无此人，[科学网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE4zX0xjUENTS3JqZ0QwQnBEazNIRU1RQnNLYzdEbHlCdHpOQXJWQmRLU3hSUVJ6ZmZRaHhnWTZrTmRSLTFHdEQxTGlBTFkzSWlJLWw1d1pCc18wcmdIQjBlOG1lUE8) 报道，此类事件频现折射出社会对名校头衔的盲目崇拜，以及平台审核责任问题。
- **九·五普法规划启动**：中共中央国务院转发《中央宣传部、司法部关于开展法治宣传教育的第九个五年规划（2026－2030年）》。[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1mMmhfVDZPanpzRllleld3YklVeXY5akZyaFl2YXBVcGpad2ZVYTdQN2dfcHo4eWNIeHN0QUxXLXVDRFpKOEtLOGMwc0R6VEpOUFFra08yY0pPUmlUVzVwTWdFcXp2UHNWNkozQWJSQzZFWll2bWtaYmNGMmxEdw) 该规划覆盖2026-2030年，旨在提升全民法治素养。

**收束判断**：中国社会新闻呈现“民生+文化”双轨叙事，减税数据强化政策获得感，申遗与文物保护优化国家形象；但对冒充教授等乱象的治理，显示出数字时代公信力维护的持久战。
中国.en:
Chinese domestic news is dominated by policy announcements, education initiatives, and international cooperation in healthcare and education. Highlights include tax relief for 126 million people, a new deputy director for the Central Social Work Department, and successful medical missions abroad. Cultural heritage and disaster prevention also feature.

- **Tax relief: 126 million people benefited from special additional deductions in H1 2026, with tax cuts exceeding 320 billion yuan.** This policy targets elderly care, medical expenses, and education, directly boosting disposable income ([China News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9BdUVaVTZYQlVkbUUzZHREbm44dGNYRzVCUXdqQi1wMnlJMzRDR3pQdmZuYnR4a2p0aHZCSmNvQjQ2aTBlQ0pITzVsblRuemMzQml3YVA0OVkxZzRuN0R0WXVLLTV1aWtacnc)).
- **Li Junbing appointed deputy director of the Central Social Work Department.** This is a key appointment in the party's social governance structure ([China Economic Net](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTFBraTNBeko2aVhUSEFBZlA2bmdHVlItZmVPT2sweHBuVG1JYVpsMTlWYlhTQWJ4UVNONTRKR2dVV2ZCVGl6b0wtVmNJSXdoZlN6N1FCMFhOZUhtX3pfOHN0eHYyNHp1RUhBX2pMdU9ISHF1dkE)).
- **China medical team performs first salivary gland imaging in Barbados.** A successful case of medical diplomacy, enhancing China's soft power ([China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9EbHV5SmNzRUhKSHlGUVY5VjVIYTlQZGRUSFE5dGdjdThDNmJHV3F3T29naFg1emFoNHNWNS1UOE11aTFEb2IzVy1za1BqSnNQWF90SVR1RGpuSzhxcWhSc0ltYlhfemRlQklaZEtqdDdJWFBFaS1lYU1qSnY)).
- **State Council issues the 9th Five-Year Plan for Legal Publicity and Education (2026-2030).** This framework aims to improve legal awareness nationwide ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1mMmhfVDZPanpzRllleld3YklVeXY5akZyaFl2YXBVcGpad2ZVYTdQN2dfcHo4eWNIeHN0QUxXLXVDRFpKOEtLOGMwc0R6VEpOUFFra08yY0pPUmlUVzVwTWdFcXp2UHNWNkozQWJSQzZFWll2bWtaYmNGMmxEdw)).
- **Zhengyangmen tower on Beijing Central Axis reopens to public.** A cultural landmark restoration, part of broader heritage preservation ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1jTTBVYVZoOHE3T1Uxd0tEcWlXZHhicndtOTRMa3gtQ0Nkd1gzMV9Sd01xVEdPUWxQTnI2RHR4NlRyb19EX1g0UGJZQl8yT3NxakFTTENwa2V1TGxUbTR3S195U05ySWNPY1ZqQmtjUmxUZFJiT0tENGNjelpTZw)).

China's domestic agenda remains focused on social stability, legal reforms, and international image-building. The tax cuts will likely support consumption, while heritage and education initiatives reinforce cultural confidence.

冲突局势.zh:
过去24小时最大变量是乌克兰在里海袭击伊朗货船，使俄乌与中东两场战争首次直接碰撞。伊朗已发出报复威胁，白宫则私下警告乌方停止此类行动以免战线失控。与此同时，美伊虽未直接交火，但胡塞武装对沙特石油设施的打击导致曼德海峡航运量骤降，凸显代理人战争的破坏力。

- **乌克兰打击伊朗货船**：据[Arab News分析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9WcDhOSWhQU1hOTEVoMUFYaWt0X0RIbnRYcml4a0xvREV0V1VFRVA3UjlFcHp2VFN6d1d1c2xmbkVDaV9ldWVyR1ZVYnAweEtRNTFJY1lQZkRGejNPZUE)，此举模糊了俄乌战争与伊朗战争（美以对伊朗）的边界，可能导致德黑兰在乌克兰战场提供更多无人机或导弹。
- **伊朗警告乌克兰**：德黑兰声明称将“以适当方式回应”，[Daily Sabah](https://news.google.)称这可能开辟伊朗战争新战线。
- **美伊暂停战斗但库存堪忧**：[战区](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uneasy-pause-in-u-s-iran-fighting-holds-amidst-growing-concerns-over-interceptor-stockpiles)指出，美伊暂停直接攻击，但沙特等盟友的防空拦截弹消耗迅速，库存短缺可能迫使美军调整部署。

收束判断：乌克兰-伊朗事件可能成为冲突扩散的转折点，后续需关注伊朗是否在叙利亚或红海开辟对乌报复行动。
冲突局势.en:
The biggest development is the Ukrainian strike on an Iranian cargo ship in the Caspian Sea, which has sparked a diplomatic crisis between Kyiv and Tehran and blurred the lines between the Ukraine-Russia and Iran-US proxy wars. Iran has threatened retaliation, while the US has warned Ukraine against further strikes on commercial vessels. Separately, Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure continue to disrupt Bab el-Mandeb shipping, even as direct US-Iran fighting has paused.

- **Ukraine strikes Iranian ship in Caspian Sea**: Kyiv attacked an Iranian cargo vessel, reportedly killing several crew members. Iran condemned the act and warned of consequences, while the White House expressed concern over the escalation. [World Socialist Web Site](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9kclNGanpMR2VsLWxFUkJ4MV93clhmWlNiaXVxUDM0V3F0em93VXpLMVRCQ3doYk43Uzk1VXhtNFd2VkZhYlIxR1dNVk5VZWltNEFmR2dkR25GMmd1ZHFjT3E1YzdpSkZo) | [Arab News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9WcDhOSWhQU1hOTEVoMUFYaWt0X0RIbnRYcml4a0xvREV0V1VFRVA3UjlFcHp2VFN6d1d1c2xmbkVDaV9ldWVyR1ZVYnAweEtRNTFJY1lQZkRGejNPZUE)
- **Iran warns Ukraine**: Iranian officials have threatened a response, raising the risk of direct Iranian involvement in the Ukraine conflict. [National Security News](https://news.google.)
- **US-Iran pause holds but proxy attacks continue**: The US and Iran have halted direct attacks, but Houthi missile strikes on Saudi oil sites have reduced shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb strait. [CNBC](https://news.google.)
- **White House warns Ukraine on cargo ship strikes**: US officials have privately cautioned Kyiv, highlighting the tension between battlefield necessity and alliance cohesion. [Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE0zVWV1RUt5WWNFOE45MEtuRldCQ2NDUGtrRTRVNTZOYlVkeG1LMzZfeEFhaHZvSW9VOW01dW9Sc3RPVzBsQ3JtOWVuYw)

**Signal**: The convergence of the Ukraine and Iran conflicts in the Caspian Sea marks a dangerous new phase; further escalation could draw in Russia and Turkey, making the Caspian a new flashpoint.

国际安全.zh:
多国军事技术出现突破性进展：澳大利亚MQ-28“幽灵蝙蝠”无人机可与美军共享指挥，高空气球变身无人机母舰，韩国开始组装舰载防空导弹原型。同时，美军弹药库存问题成为跨领域焦点，乌克兰获得的新型远程导弹AGM-188A“锈匕首”细节曝光。

- **MQ-28可由美军飞行员控制**：[战区报道](https://www.twz.com/air/australian-mq-28-ghost-bat-fighter-drones-could-be-commanded-by-u-s-pilots)称，美澳正测试协同作战飞机（CCA）的跨军种直连能力，战时美军可直接指挥澳方无人机，极大提升联合作战弹性。
- **高空气球成无人机母舰**：[Aerostar公司](https://www.twz.com/news-features/aerostar-high-altitude-balloons-being-turned-into-drone-motherships)将平流层气球改造为无人机发射平台，可长时间广域监视并实施打击，成本远低于卫星和有人机。
- **韩国KSAM-II导弹开始组装**：[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lig-da-begins-assembly-prototype-ksam-ii-missile-rok-navy/)披露，韩国LIG D&A已启动“舰空导弹-II”原型弹装配，旨在替代美制SM-2，增强韩海军自主防空能力。
- **乌克兰AGM-188A“锈匕首”**：[报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNajREbjB4Mk9HM1ZJTi1SZVhkcWliM1paRS04MkNFUGYzeHRRN0VwbDJGb2xEbGc3aXcwdkNHQkR4bXJuQXVxQ2l4T1JzNVVpYnB2aEUxSV9TNHZuRm9iLUtfS1hpSVI0SEpDdVF5OUhKUEtuTlBlU1hEX3VsMERxUnVWUDZEZWVXa09zeFZzZGNzT1JQSi1CWDN6bzYxU21VZldTUHFXMmd4YnpaeDVwS2dqMUxnOWtHaW00)**：俄军缴获的导弹残骸显示该弹采用抗干扰GPS天线，来自挪威康斯伯格，显示西方技术深度嵌入乌远程打击系统。

收束判断：无人化、自主化、低成本化是军事技术演进主方向，美日韩澳的技术整合将重塑印太战力平衡，弹药补给能力是未来冲突的决胜短板。
国际安全.en:
Global security developments this cycle highlight the accelerating race to field advanced drones, the strain on US munition stockpiles, and Europe's adaptation to a new security environment. Key stories include the US-Australian integration of MQ-28 Ghost Bat drones, the Navy's first combat use of a kamikaze USV at RIMPAC, and Austria's decision to extend conscription.

- **Australian MQ-28 Ghost Bat drones may be commanded by US pilots**: This integration of Collaborative Combat Aircraft could revolutionize coalition airpower, allowing seamless control in contested environments. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/australian-mq-28-ghost-bat-fighter-drones-could-be-commanded-by-u-s-pilots)
- **US Navy's GARC kamikaze drone boat blew a hole in ex-USS Peleliu**: The sinking exercise at RIMPAC demonstrated the lethality of unmanned surface vessels just days after their first combat use. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/navys-garc-kamikaze-drone-boat-blew-a-hole-in-ex-uss-peleliu-during-sinking-exercise)
- **Austria plans to extend military service to 9 months**: The move reflects growing European concern over the Russia threat, even for traditionally neutral states. [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/2026/07/27/austria-plans-to-extend-military-service-in-light-of-ukraine-war/)
- **US interceptor stockpile concerns mount**: The uneasy pause in US-Iran fighting underscores the need to rebuild missile defense inventory, as Houthi attacks continue. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uneasy-pause-in-u-s-iran-fighting-holds-amidst-growing-concerns-over-interceptor-stockpiles)
- **Aerostar high-altitude balloons being turned into drone motherships**: Stratospheric balloons could provide persistent surveillance and strike capability over vast areas. [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/aerostar-high-altitude-balloons-being-turned-into-drone-motherships)

**Signal**: The rapid fielding of unmanned and autonomous systems is outpacing traditional procurement cycles; the US and its allies must invest in munitions and C4ISR to maintain overmatch.

中国军情.zh:
中国在台海与南海同时展现存在：解放军直升机与无人机首次协同越过台海中线，引发台湾方面紧张；南海方面，中国海警救助沉没越南货船47名船员获国际赞誉。此外，一位中国女军事专家因公开资料准确推演美军航母航线而引发外媒关注，显示解放军情报分析能力提升。

- **台海：直升机与无人机首次同时越线**：据[朝鲜日报中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdkpDbEVHbWVtZFN2RXJFMGtCTnVYaUw3NVdwdWZTY0pFcEM5WUZoejZackNZSFJPeVhORkIzeEdFTmlla2Zvb0h0X0dnNERnSkhmLW1NRXdEZW9VblZaM1Zib01GTXRGM1o1OHJzZ09fRFVHZm5kd1NnSUJZYS1mQXdzWXRBOWs)**，台“国防部”证实两架直升机与一架无人机进入“西南空域”，系首次混合编队越线，被解读为对台军演“镇海”的回应。
- **南海救援彰显软实力**：越南货船在南海沉没，[中方共救起47人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFA1MWNLREp2eWNoTm5CaTVRcVdaVUpieWlXZVJQaV9KREZpMzd0Zjk0XzBveVdIa1JxM1RJbVc5QUs2Mk4zTXBpa1Fod0FWbi1sT3g0aVYxb3RfOFNpeFdfdXNaUmpYN2l2UmpLN0JvTE9sVjYtU3FEYQ)**，获救船员集体用中文致谢，事件被美日媒体关注，被视为中国强化南海存在合法性的有效行动。
- **女专家推演美军航线**：据[手机新浪网](https://news.google.)**，中国女军官仅凭公开航班和AIS数据准确预测美军航母航线，外媒称此能力在冲突中意味着先发制人的基础。
- **美将中企列入军事清单**：[商务部回应](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)称此举破坏全球供应链，涉及多家科技公司。

收束判断：中国正系统性展示在台海与南海的双重行动控制力，同时通过救援行动塑造负责任大国形象，军事与民事手段协同推进既定战略。
中国军情.en:
China's military activities continue to intensify across multiple domains. A Vietnamese cargo ship sank in the South China Sea, with Chinese forces rescuing 47 crew members, while Chinese helicopters and UAVs crossed the Taiwan Strait median line simultaneously for the first time. Beijing also blacklisted a Polish university and targeted a US warship design in missile tests.

- **Chinese helicopters and UAVs cross Taiwan Strait median line simultaneously**: This new operational pattern signals increased pressure on Taiwan and tests 'status quo' norms. [朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdkpDbEVHbWVtZFN2RXJFMGtCTnVYaUw3NVdwdWZTY0pFcEM5WUZoejZackNZSFJPeVhORkIzeEdFTmlla2Zvb0h0X0dnNERnSkhmLW1NRXdEZW9VblZaM1Zib01GTXRGM1o1OHJzZ09fRFVHZm5kd1NnSUJZYS1mQXdzWXRBOWs)
- **China makes new US warship target for missile tests**: The PLA is reportedly using a simulated US warship as a target for anti-ship ballistic missiles, enhancing its deterrence posture. [The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNbzZVbkNfVXhIa1hDeHF5b1FMOE1WQnVRY3BtTVhBRm1QT3ZSUkpkeUJ6MkhCSWFpVUI4a3dWV3NtRGN2T1pSZVFqc2l2MkNHOHBGR3BQdGxyUDZoQlhxTVJYaWtxdnkzR21mVnQ3eG8zVkp4TU85Z0FuaDhiTTBhWnJ4R1Z1c3BybTJiU0hwb0s)
- **China rescues 47 Vietnamese sailors after cargo ship sinks in South China Sea**: The incident highlights humanitarian cooperation amid territorial disputes. [新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFA1MWNLREp2eWNoTm5CaTVRcVdaVUpieWlXZVJQaV9KREZpMzd0Zjk0XzBveVdIa1JxM1RJbVc5QUs2Mk4zTXBpa1Fod0FWbi1sT3g0aVYxb3RfOFNpeFdfdXNaUmpYN2l2UmpLN0JvTE9sVjYtU3FEYQ)
- **China blacklists a Polish university for the first time**: Beijing's expanding use of sanctions targets institutions that may have engaged in sensitive technology transfer. [观察者](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE9FUDBVMTY5V3lMc1ZUQUNpQ2VYbzNmWWFWRVptT2w3TUFDemxlU0JCM3VWaEppaDVHUzlISXdNYXFJX054NzhtS0VURDVyQWZ3TFFQdG9kN3FfZW1hR2x4M2djVDdIdnFzMVE)

**Signal**: China is systematically increasing military pressure on Taiwan while demonstrating long-range strike capabilities and expanding its influence through both coercion and humanitarian actions in the South China Sea.

海军与印太.zh:
印太海上态势紧张升级：美军“乔治·华盛顿”号航母打击群在中菲冲突后进入南海，系近两月来首次出现在该区域。同时，RIMPAC期间美海军用自杀式无人艇击沉两栖攻击舰，测试新战术。澳大利亚推进军港扩建，韩国自研舰空导弹进入原型阶段，印太海军力量竞逐加速。

- **“乔治·华盛顿”号航母进入南海**：据[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/george-washington-csg-in-the-south-china-sea-after-philippine-chinese-clashes)，该航母编队经吕宋海峡进入南海，此前在菲律宾海活动两月。此举明显是对6月-7月中菲海上对峙的回应，显示美军维持南海存在。
- **RIMPAC无人艇实战化测试**：美海军GARC[自杀式无人艇](https://www.twz.com/sea/navys-garc-kamikaze-drone-boat-blew-a-hole-in-ex-uss-peleliu-during-sinking-exercise)在击沉演习中精准命中退役两栖攻击舰“佩莱利乌”号，造成致命破口。这是在实战中首次使用自杀式USV后的第二次展示，标志非对称作战能力成熟。
- **澳大利亚布里斯班船厂项目**：[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/the-cairncross-dockyard-brisbane-project-and-prospects-for-australian-naval-infrastructure)报道耗资25亿澳元的凯恩克罗斯船厂项目已获州政府批准，将增强澳本土造修舰能力，支撑核潜艇及大型水面舰计划。
- **韩国KSAM-II导弹原型组装**：LIG D&A开始[组装舰空导弹-II](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lig-da-begins-assembly-prototype-ksam-ii-missile-rok-navy/)，计划替代SM-2，由韩国自主开发，将装备新一代驱逐舰，减少对美依赖。
- **美多国联合演习**：[美国海军](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/u-k-spanish-navy-forces-wrap-natos-latest-neptune-strike-exercise)与英国、西班牙等在北大西洋完成“海王星打击”演习，英航母与西海军两栖群协同，强化北约北部防线。

收束判断：印太海域正成为大国海军新技术与新部署的试验场，无人艇、自研导弹与传统航母力量并行发展，未来冲突的节奏将由这些“非对称颠覆”能力重新定义。
海军与印太.en:
Naval and Indo-Pacific developments center on the US Navy's forward presence in the South China Sea, RIMPAC exercises demonstrating new strike capabilities, and allied naval infrastructure investments. The George Washington CSG is back in the South China Sea after Philippine-Chinese clashes, while the UK and Spanish navies wrapped up NATO's Neptune Strike in the North Atlantic.

- **USS George Washington CSG in South China Sea**: The return of the forward-deployed carrier strike group follows clashes between Philippine and Chinese forces, signaling US commitment to freedom of navigation. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/george-washington-csg-in-the-south-china-sea-after-philippine-chinese-clashes)
- **Royal Australian Navy fires Naval Strike Missile at RIMPAC**: Australia demonstrates its anti-ship capability as part of the multinational exercise. [Zona Militar](https://news.google.)
- **UK-Spanish naval forces wrap up NATO Neptune Strike 26-3**: The exercise spanned the High North and North Atlantic, involving multiple allied nations to enhance rapid response capabilities. [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/27/u-k-spanish-navy-forces-wrap-natos-latest-neptune-strike-exercise)
- **Australia's Cairncross Dockyard Brisbane project advances**: A $2.5 billion investment to resurrect a working shipyard in Brisbane, boosting regional naval maintenance capacity. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/the-cairncross-dockyard-brisbane-project-and-prospects-for-australian-naval-infrastructure/)
- **South Korea begins assembly of KSAM-II prototype missiles**: The indigenous SM-2 replacement project for the ROK Navy moves into flight-test production. [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lig-da-begins-assembly-prototype-ksam-ii-missile-rok-navy/)

**Signal**: The Indo-Pacific region remains the center of naval competition, with US carrier presence, allied exercises, and infrastructure investments all signaling a long-term commitment to deterrence and power projection.

科技产品.zh: 今日产品动态多集中于支付、系统更新与宕机事件。X Money 作为马斯克“万物应用”的核心，终于向美国 Premium 用户开放数字钱包及 Visa 卡 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971649/x-money-launch-elon-musk))；但仅限付费用户的做法可能限制其初期渗透。Claude 的隐私泄露事件警示所有 AI 聊天工具——共享链接可能被搜索引擎索引 ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/private-claude-chats-exposed-in-google-and-bing-search-results/))，用户需谨慎。苹果推送 iOS/macOS 26.6，这是秋季大版本前最后一次里程碑更新 ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/ios-and-macos-26-6-arrive-today-paving-the-way-for-ios-and-macos-27/))。Xbox 大宕机让实体盘玩家也受影响，数字依赖的脆弱性再次暴露 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/971545/xbox-outage-disc-physical-games))。此外，Starlink 获得 FCC 对越南产路由器的豁免，政策弹性值得关注 ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/starlink-gets-exemption-from-fcc-ban-on-routers-made-outside-the-us/))。总体看，平台控制力与用户隐私的矛盾正在加深。
科技产品.en:
The 科技产品 desk covers a mix of hardware launches, service outages, and policy moves. Key themes include X Money’s limited US rollout, Apple’s final 26.6 updates, and growing reliance on compact nuclear reactors for military bases. Meanwhile, severe service disruptions at Xbox, Spotify, and Claude underscore systemic reliability challenges.

- **X Money launches** — digital wallet and metal Visa card for Premium subscribers, with Apple Wallet support and limited availability ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/971649/x-money-launch-elon-musk), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2224633/x-money-begins-limited-us-rollout/)).
- **iOS and macOS 26.6 arrive** — likely the final updates before the fall 27 release, paving the way for new hardware and features ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/ios-and-macos-26-6-arrive-today-paving-the-way-for-ios-and-macos-27/)).
- **Claude private chats leaked** via share-chat indexing on Google and Bing, exposing a gap in web crawler controls ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/private-claude-chats-exposed-in-google-and-bing-search-results/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/psa-your-claude-shared-chats-and-artifacts-may-have-ended-up-on-google/)).
- **Antares raises $470M** for small modular reactors (100 kW–1 MW) to power US Air Force bases, blending defense needs with clean energy tech ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/antares-raises-470m-to-build-nuclear-reactors-for-the-u-s-military/)).
- **Xbox outage blocked disc-based games** — an extended failure that prevented logins and app launches, affecting even physical media ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/971545/xbox-outage-disc-physical-games)).

This desk signals a growing tension between innovation (X Money, nuclear reactors) and operational reliability (outages, privacy leaks) that will shape consumer trust in 2026.

汽车.zh: 比亚迪今日强势刷屏：旗舰电动轿车确认续航超 1000 公里，预计下月首发 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/))；同时 Seal 06 公布官图，尺寸对标 Model 3 但价格仅一半 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-seal-06-ev-images-launch/))。日本市场也被比亚迪以微型电动 Kei 车切入 ([Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxON21GSVVSUEJxQ2x0VjBfR3M3bzdpRXMxNTBfampwaUFuUVJpYWliRVhxM2kwUklQeG1Rc0wyMTNuODdkdGFtU0RiOFZIUFJCODFkb2V2dHpJdk9HNE5vdkVKUmZzU2hPMy1ISHVpVmFYdGlQaGhDNDkxT3NGZDZ3TFFuZ0k))。奔驰全新 C 级电动首驾评价很高，续航出色但内饰触控屏仍被批评 ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2220206/2027-mercedes-benz-c-class-electric-first-drive/))。Rivian R2 的真实世界能耗对比 Model Y 劣势明显（高 18%-26%），EPA 同等标称下实际差距巨大 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/rivian-r2-tesla-model-y-real-world-efficiency-test/))。充电基础设施层面，Bojangles 快餐连锁加入 DC 快充网络，体现“餐饮+充电”模式扩展 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/now-bojangles-wants-ev-drivers-to-fast-charge-while-they-eat/))。市场判断：中国品牌在续航和价格上形成双重冲击，美国车企亟需提升能效数据透明度。
汽车.en:
The 汽车 desk is dominated by BYD’s aggressive global push — from a 1,008 km flagship sedan to a tiny kei car for Japan — and by new EV entries from Mercedes, BMW, and Kia. Charging infrastructure expands beyond Tesla with Bojangles’ first DC fast charger, while real-world efficiency tests reveal a gap between Rivian R2 and Tesla Model Y.

- **BYD unveils 1,008 km range flagship EV** — a new sedan with class-leading range, spotted ahead of its August debut ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/byd-reveals-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/)).
- **BYD takes on Japan’s kei car market** with a tiny EV, challenging domestic giants on their home turf ([Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxON21GSVVSUEJxQ2x0VjBfR3M3bzdpRXMxNTBfampwaUFuUVJpYWliRVhxM2kwUklQeG1Rc0wyMTNuODdkdGFtU0RiOFZIUFJCODFkb2V2dHpJdk9HNE5vdkVKUmZzU2hPMy1ISHVpVmFYdGlQaGhDNDkxT3NGZDZ3TFFuZ0k)).
- **Mercedes C-Class Electric first drive** — praised for range and ride quality, but the dashboard UI draws criticism ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2220206/2027-mercedes-benz-c-class-electric-first-drive/)).
- **Bojangles enters EV charging** — the fast-food chain installs its first DC fast charger in Savannah, Georgia, with dozens more planned ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/now-bojangles-wants-ev-drivers-to-fast-charge-while-they-eat/)).
- **Rivian R2 uses 18–26% more energy than Tesla Model Y** in real-world tests, despite identical EPA ratings — a mismatch that could affect buyer perception ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/rivian-r2-tesla-model-y-real-world-efficiency-test/)).

The automotive desk is watching BYD’s dual-pronged assault on range leadership and niche markets, while legacy automakers scramble to match efficiency and charging convenience.

AI.zh: 今日 AI 焦点围绕安全、泄露与开源竞争。Claude 共享聊天被搜索引擎抓取事件 ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/private-claude-chats-exposed-in-google-and-bing-search-results/); [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/psa-your-claude-shared-chats-and-artifacts-may-have-ended-up-on-google/)) 令人质疑 Anthropic 的产品设计。微软高调发布 MAI-Cyber-1-Flash 安全模型及 Perception 平台 ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/microsoft-launches-its-first-cyber-model-and-a-new-agentic-cybersecurity-system/); [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-unveils-ai-security-tools-it-says-outperform-competing-platforms/))，声称成本更低、性能更强，直接对标 OpenAI、Google 等对手。OpenAI 此前在 Hugging Face 的模型越狱事件 ([MIT Tech Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/27/1140836/openai-hugging-face-attack-precedent/)) 引发对齐与控制路线之争。与此同时，中国开源模型 Kimi K3 的性价比引发硅谷焦虑 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/971444/how-chinese-open-weight-ai-models-impact-us-companies))；Anthropic CEO 表示不反对开源但担忧中国 AI ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/anthropics-dario-amodei-responds-doesnt-oppose-open-weight-models-but-fears-chinese-ai/))。另外 Meta 为 AI 数据中心放弃可再生能源承诺，投资 10 座天然气电厂 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/meta-is-backing-10-gas-plants-and-just-quit-a-global-renewables-pledge/))，能源与环境矛盾激化。后续观察：AI 安全市场正在形成“军备竞赛”，微软利用企业关系优势切入；而开源模型的低成本和中国突破可能改变全球竞争格局。
AI.en:
The AI desk is buzzing with model launches, security breaches, and geopolitical undercurrents. Microsoft debuted its first cybersecurity AI model, Anthropic’s CEO clashed over open-weight risks, and Claude’s private chats were exposed. Meanwhile, China’s open-weight Kimi K3 model is unsettling Silicon Valley, and Meta’s pivot to gas plants highlights the energy cost of AI scale.

- **Microsoft launches MAI-Cyber-1-Flash** — a new AI security model and agentic platform, claiming superior performance and lower cost than competitors ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/microsoft-unveils-ai-security-tools-it-says-outperform-competing-platforms/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/microsoft-launches-its-first-cyber-model-and-a-new-agentic-cybersecurity-system/)).
- **Anthropic’s Amodei: not anti-open-weight, but fears Chinese AI** — responds to growing tensions over open models and national security ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/anthropics-dario-amodei-responds-doesnt-oppose-open-weight-models-but-fears-chinese-ai/)).
- **Claude Opus 5 announced** — Anthropic’s latest high-performance, cost-efficient model, raising the bar for enterprise AI ([Tekedia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPUlpiUTZjSnNzVzZVbUpDR0NKVHNvd1UzdDU1bWx1aGF1UG84NFlISTNlcTlyc2ZlWkQyZjRPVWl3V0JOZF9jLWxJTTIwMzNMNjF2YkRLVDdsVTdJVWdhY0p0NUI1cFNwQUNtV211VXJEclNNaWNMMnZJSnNaOTA0bUFkUy1EeDJ6SE1UN1BjRTA3ck05dzhNTmRZTEgtVk8xUm12VnJn)).
- **Meta backs 10 gas plants for AI data centers** — quits RE100 renewable pledge, signaling a shift away from green energy commitments ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/27/meta-is-backing-10-gas-plants-and-just-quit-a-global-renewables-pledge/)).
- **China’s open-weight Kimi K3 model threatens US dominance** — can beat top US systems at a fraction of the cost, intensifying the AI rivalry ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/971444/how-chinese-open-weight-ai-models-impact-us-companies)).

The AI desk underscores a triple tension: model performance vs. cost, open vs. closed weights, and US vs. China — all against a backdrop of escalating energy demands and security vulnerabilities.

HackNews社区动态.zh: Hacker News 今日讨论趋重技术哲学与组织文化。一篇博文《Using an open model feels surprisingly good》获得 88 分，反映社区对开放模型的偏好 ([Hacker News](https://matthewsaltz.com/blog/using-an-open-model-feels-surprisingly-good/))。实操层面，有用户仅用 500 美元 RL 微调 9B 开源模型，即在目录审查任务上超越前沿模型 ([Hacker News](https://fermisense.com/when-machines-take-the-wheel/))，证明小成本微调依然有效。关于安全的讨论中，`Residential Proxies Are a National Security Threat` 一文分析了住宅代理被滥用的国家安全风险 ([Hacker News](https://jacob.gold/posts/residential-proxies-are-a-national-security-threat/))。文化方面，Netflix 因信任游戏解雇员工的故事以 211 点高居榜首 ([Hacker News](https://nypost.com/2026/07/26/us-news/netflix-exec-goes-ballistic-after-being-fired-for-stunning-trust-exercise-confession-at-retreat-suit/))，引发对硅谷内部隐私边界的讨论。技术前沿：D 语言社区 DConf 2026 在伦敦举办 ([Hacker News](https://dconf.org/2026/index.html))，以及 C/C++ 项目打包为 Zig 的尝试 ([Hacker News](https://github.com/allyourcodebase)) 显示出语言生态的活跃。宇航员长期任务后的“旁观者”感觉报告 ([Hacker News](https://spacedaily.com/sd-v-astronauts-returning-from-six-month-missions-describe-a-persistent-observer-sensation-the-feeling-of-watching-their-own-lives-from-a-half-step-outside-the-frame-weeks-after-theyr/)) 则提供了有趣的心理学视角。整体而言，社区同时关注实用微调、安全威胁和人性化体验。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community is engaging with a mix of practical open-source insights, security warnings, and cultural reflections. Highlights include a developer’s surprise at how good open models feel, a $500 fine-tune that outperforms frontier models, and a call to treat residential proxies as a national security threat. A notable outlier is an article on astronauts experiencing a persistent ‘observer’ sensation after long missions.

- **“Using an open model feels surprisingly good”** — a personal essay on the ease and quality of open-weight AI, resonating with many developers ([Hacker News](https://matthewsaltz.com/blog/using-an-open-model-feels-surprisingly-good/)).
- **$500 RL fine-tune of 9B open model beats frontier models** on catalog review tasks, demonstrating the power of targeted fine-tuning ([Hacker News](https://fermisense.com/when-machines-take-the-wheel/)).
- **Residential proxies: a national security threat** — argues that proxy networks enable large-scale fraud and espionage, sparking debate on regulation ([Hacker News](https://jacob.gold/posts/residential-proxies-are-a-national-security-threat/)).
- **Astronauts describe ‘observer’ sensation after 6-month missions** — a feeling of watching their own lives from outside, persisting for weeks after return ([Hacker News](https://spacedaily.com/sd-v-astronauts-returning-from-six-month-missions-describe-a-persistent-observer-sensation-the-feeling-of-watching-their-own-lives-from-a-half-step-outside-the-frame-weeks-after-theyr/)).
- **Netflix employee fired for sharing personal details in retreat trust exercise** — a cautionary tale about workplace vulnerability and legal consequences ([Hacker News](https://nypost.com/2026/07/26/us-news/netflix-exec-goes-ballistic-after-being-fired-for-stunning-trust-exercise-confession-at-retreat-suit/)).

The HackNews desk reflects the community’s focus on practical AI efficacy, security trade-offs, and human factors in technology — a counterpoint to the corporate narratives dominating other desks.

足球.zh:
今日足球转会市场剧烈震荡：英格兰中卫斯通斯口头同意加盟国米，切尔西转而追击亨德森与维尔贝克，显示英超豪门后防更新换代加速。同时，英足总新规针对门将拖延时间，或将改变比赛节奏。
- **斯通斯决定投奔国米**：据 [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cgewgj8qwvjo) 和 [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567544/john-stones-transfer-news-england-international-verbally-agrees-deal-to-join-inter-milan-amid-interest-from-arsenal-and-chelsea) 报道，斯通斯已与国米达成口头协议，夏季自由身加盟。此举让此前追逐他的阿森纳和切尔西落空，后者可能加速中卫其他目标。
- **切尔西洽谈亨德森与维尔贝克**：BBC确认切尔西已开启与布伦特福德中场亨德森和布莱顿前锋维尔贝克的转会谈判，旨在弥补斯通斯未果的锋线/中场空缺。
- **英足总试行门将战术暂停禁令**：新赛季英格兰各级别联赛将试点禁止门将通过倒地等方式拖延时间， [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyjxd53zkpo) 称此举或减少比赛中断，但门将需适应新规则。
收束：国米收获顶级中卫后防线升级，切尔西引援方向调整后面临中场和锋线补强挑战，英足总新规将考验门将的应急能力。
足球.en:
The football desk was dominated by transfer speculation and a significant rule change trial, though the raw feed also included non-football items (cricket, tennis, swimming, etc.) that we set aside for this report. Key storylines: England defender John Stones appears set to leave Manchester City for Inter Milan on a free transfer, with verbal agreement reported by Sky in Italy. Chelsea are actively rebuilding under new management, opening talks for Brentford's Jordan Henderson and Brighton's Danny Welbeck. Meanwhile, English football will trial new rules to eliminate goalkeeper 'tactical timeouts' this season. The Vinicius Junior saga continues with Arsenal interest and Real Madrid's pursuit of Yan Diomande.

- [John Stones verbally agrees Inter move amid Arsenal, Chelsea interest](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567544/john-stones-transfer-news-england-international-verbally-agrees-deal-to-join-inter-milan-amid-interest-from-arsenal-and-chelsea)
- [Chelsea open talks to sign Henderson and Welbeck](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2d79ddvg4o)
- [English football agrees trial to end goalkeeper tactical timeouts](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyjxd53zkpo)
- [What Arsenal's interest and Real's Diomande pursuit mean for Vini Jr](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567372/vinicius-jr-transfer-news-arsenal-interest-explained-as-real-madrid-step-up-efforts-to-sign-yan-diomande-from-rb-leipzig)
- [Liverpool's centre-back situation and why Iraola must act](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpw9zw972l2o)

**Signal:** The Stones transfer, if completed, would be a major coup for Inter and a blow to City's defensive depth. Chelsea's aggressive pursuit of high-mileage veterans signals a pragmatic approach to immediate competitiveness.

篮球.zh:
CBA选秀大会落幕，台湾控卫宋昕澔成为状元，但媒体讨论焦点却落在欧洲联赛对CBA外援的“虹吸效应”上。此外，直播吧成为亚洲大学生篮球联赛官方合作伙伴，显示篮球下沉市场热度。
- **宋昕澔当选CBA状元**：广州队用状元签选中23岁宝岛控卫，他透露与陈盈骏、陈国豪早有交流，并称CBA对抗极强。此举可能增强广州后场深度。
- **欧洲联赛吸引力超过CBA**：媒体人对比发现欧洲联赛合同保障更好、体系更成熟，导致多名CBA外援流失。原文分析指出 [CBA需改善合同稳定性与风格](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNMDdRbW1FYi14RV9OR2Q2ODVEbGlPOURPdUsxMk8tSnNxRDk4VVdBSUVPd0dFX25aOUJkME9XRGtHeFd3UEdwMTFQU0tfSVcybWNubXFCeWNkOGZDUHFrVGdBR21YaTNUbXl1WVg5UE0tSTRjVDM3bm5TUFZnd3dBdy1VZ1VPcUtoZUlNdS1Kdw) 才能挽回颓势。
- **直播吧签约亚洲大学生篮球联赛**：成为官方媒体合作伙伴，将扩大校园篮球在华人地区的传播，可能带动更多年轻受众关注。
收束：CBA选秀表面热闹，但外援流失警报未解除；国内篮球生态需在青训与商业运营上双向发力。
篮球.en:
Basketball news centered on the CBA draft and the ongoing debate about the league's appeal to foreign players. The Guangzhou Loong Lions selected Taiwanese guard Song Xinhao as the No. 1 overall pick, and Song later revealed he had prior communication with CBA veterans Chen Yingjun and Chen Guohao. Meanwhile, several Chinese media analyses argued that European leagues offer stronger contracts and better competition, making them more attractive to top players than the CBA. The Asian University Basketball League also gained a media partner. No major NBA news appeared in this window.

- [状元及第！CBA选秀大会：广州用状元签选中宝岛23岁控卫宋昕澔](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1TRnFNLUpuR01QR28tTDNweFRnd2I0ZFpqTzR1LWMzcFptUXdaN0hZTHdfbVV5dkVNYll2M1VJcWVnT1BzSXZ0UkJmOUF0YjNkdHVEenZCQ1VmOURJWlljWUZ3TW9ZcWo1WV96NTlZWQ)

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑社区今日热点呈现多元体育话题：电竞方面Zeus复盘MSI选蒙多引发LOL玩家热议；乒超冷门刷屏；裁判踩踏事件出圈；丁俊晖连胜吸引台球粉丝。
- **Zeus复盘MSI选蒙多**：T1上单Zeus在直播中回顾MSI选蒙多决策，引发对BP思路的讨论，相关帖子在虎扑热度飙升。
- **乒超男团：上海地产首败**：林诗栋缺阵后上海地产2-8负于黄石东楚，山东魏桥六连胜领跑，虎扑用户讨论阵容轮换影响。
- **定南赣联官员踩踏裁判被禁赛7个月**：官方处罚出炉，此事件在虎扑引发对足球纪律的严厉批评。
- **丁俊晖上海大师赛4-0领先**：上半场完胜姚东成，虎扑台球区期待他后续表现。
- **罗马诺二人骂战**：爆料曾互动的两位记者如今反目成仇，虎扑用户调侃“商业互吹破裂”。
收束：虎扑社区覆盖项目广泛，从电竞到传统台球均有讨论热点，反映出泛体育用户的活跃度。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The HuPu community feed covered a diverse mix of esports, table tennis, football officiating scandals, snooker, and nostalgic NBA content. Notable items: Zeus reviewed his MSI performance with a controversial Mundo pick; Shanghai Dichi lost in the CTTSL without Lin Shidong; a football official was banned 7 months for stamping on a referee; and Ronnie O'Sullivan's retirement deadline sparked discussion. Also, Kevin Love shared family photos with former teammates. The community also debated the Spanish player market values and a personal feud between two football journalists.

羽毛球.zh:
羽毛球板块今日消息较少，仅有一条BWF世锦赛新闻更新，但作为年度最高级别赛事的备战期，各国家队正在调整参赛名单与训练计划。
- **BWF世锦赛动态**：官方发布最新 [新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQZU1TYjlNYzY1clQ1c0xYbHBEdjJTRmhlOU1md1JGT3NiR3ZaeVQ5aV9VTUNOczBqLU1ZU1JSblMwMGg5c29pakU3bC0yd0xLc3hCcGh6enB5N1VKVHBOcG9ZNmpuVno5MDZRUFFiQm9Ta2dKR0hmbmlXaGtuWG1LUHNSQ2U1TzdIMEZGbUU5LUNvUWdJVlhfa21EM3ZseGRRa0Y4VjJaVkZiLXVGZ21vWXNxYnpXdUl3MmdpWHdPSWY3bHpCYk9KSE5R)，虽然标题简略，但暗示世锦赛筹备进入关键期。中国羽毛球队近期伤病情况未知，需密切关注名将如石宇奇、陈雨菲的参赛状态。
- **后续关注**：随着世锦赛临近，种子签位、对手分析及热身赛成绩将成为虎扑羽毛球区主要讨论点。
收束：羽毛球新闻虽少，但世锦赛前瞻值得持续跟踪，建议关注后续中国羽协公布的参赛名单。
羽毛球.en:
The only item in the badminton desk is a generic link to the BWF World Championships news page, with no specific article about recent matches or developments. This suggests either a lull in major tournament activity or limited coverage in the last 24 hours. No other badminton stories were detected across the feeds.

日韩.zh:
### 日韩娱乐
今日韩娱动态以“人员变动”和“活动预告”为主轴。iKON成员Junhoe正式宣布入伍，这是继B.I、金振焕之后又一位主力成员服役，iKON短期内完整体活动几无可能。同时，ZEROBASEONE金志雄因演员行程缺席部分团体活动，团体管理再度面临“偶像-演员”双栖难题。颁奖季预热：**2026 AAA**公布首批阵容（主持池昌旭×张员瑛），VERIVERY公布全球巡演日程。剧集方面，《明天见》收视率逆势上扬至4.6%大结局在即，孔孝真新作《A Bona Fide Killer》释放预热看点。

- [iKON’s Junhoe Announces Military Enlistment Date](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857924wpp/ikons-junhoe-announces-military-enlistment-date) — 143娱乐确认，即日起iKON仅剩少数成员未服役，粉丝需做好长期等待准备。
- [2026 Asia Artist Awards (AAA) Announces First Artist Lineup](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857943wpp/2026-asia-artist-awards-aaa-announces-first-artist-lineup) — 12月高雄开唱，首批名单未公布具体艺人，但预计将涵盖顶级K-POP团体。
- [ZEROBASEONE’s Kim Ji Woong To Partially Sit Out Group Activities Due To Scheduling Conflicts](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857935wpp/zerobaseones-kim-ji-woong-to-partially-sit-out-group-activities-due-to-scheduling-conflicts) — 将缺席SBS歌谣大庆夏季特辑，公司称“优先保障组合活动”，外界猜测其个人演技资源或已至饱和。
- [“See You At Work Tomorrow!” Remains No. 1 With Boost In Ratings Ahead Of Finale](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857923wpp/see-you-at-work-tomorrow-remains-no-1-with-boost-in-ratings-ahead-of-finale) — 徐仁国、朴智贤主演剧集大结局前创下4.6%收视，稳居同时段冠军，有望冲击tvN下半年最佳收视。
- [“Agent Kim Reactivated” Cast Shares Gratitude And Reflects On Drama’s Successful Run](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857825wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-cast-shares-gratitude-and-reflects-on-dramas-successful-run) — 苏志燮主演剧集收官，改编自人气网络漫画，口碑与收视双收，为后续同类作品提供了“中年英雄”范本。

综合来看，**“军白期”与“个人行程冲突”正成为当前K-POP团体运营的核心挑战**，而AAA等大型颁奖礼的回归则给市场注入强心剂。
日韩.en:
The Korean entertainment sector saw a mix of enlistment announcements and drama successes. iKON's Junhoe confirmed his enlistment date, impacting group schedules, while ZEROBASEONE's Kim Ji Woong will miss some activities due to acting commitments. The drama 'See You at Work Tomorrow!' achieved a ratings boost ahead of its finale, and multiple upcoming dramas like 'Flex x Cop 2' and 'A Bona Fide Killer' are generating anticipation.

- [iKON’s Junhoe Announces Military Enlistment Date](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857924wpp/ikons-junhoe-announces-military-enlistment-date) — Agency statement confirms his enlistment, leaving fans to navigate a period without the group.
- [ZEROBASEONE’s Kim Ji Woong To Partially Sit Out Group Activities Due To Scheduling Conflicts](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857935wpp/zerobaseones-kim-ji-woong-to-partially-sit-out-group-activities-due-to-scheduling-conflicts) — Nest Management cites acting schedule; he will miss SBS Gayo Daejeon Summer.
- [“See You At Work Tomorrow!” Remains No. 1 With Boost In Ratings Ahead Of Finale](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857923wpp/see-you-at-work-tomorrow-remains-no-1-with-boost-in-ratings-ahead-of-finale) — Ratings rose to 4.6% as the Seo In Guk drama approaches its conclusion.
- [VERIVERY Announces Schedule For “GIVE ME FIVE, KEEP THAT VIBE” Tour](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857916wpp/verivery-announces-schedule-for-give-me-five-keep-that-vibe-tour) — The tour includes Seoul, Jakarta, and multiple European cities starting October.

Overall, K-pop and K-drama fans face a period of adjustment as key idols enlist or juggle schedules, while new content continues to draw viewers.

欧美.zh:
### 欧美娱乐
欧美板块今日由**《蜘蛛侠：新一天》**首映霸榜。Zendaya以“蛛丝灵感”礼服惊艳红毯，Tom Holland则强调新片“更成熟更黑暗”，标志着荷兰弟版蜘蛛侠转型成人化。漫威宇宙另一重磅：**罗伯特·唐尼为毁灭博士配音**，罗素兄弟称其声线“令人战栗”，预示《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》反派塑造将颠覆预期。此外，Ariana Grande起诉黑客泄露未发布内容，Sean Astin自曝因《指环王》片酬不足被迫卖房，Justin Baldoni旗下工作室需赔偿《纽约时报》17.1万美元——好莱坞薪酬与版权纠纷持续发酵。新片竞标方面：**New Line赢得《嫉妒的人是丑陋的》版权**，该恐怖片由希腊/英国导演Theo James Krekis执导。

- [Tom Holland Says ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Is “More Mature”](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-mature-film-1237005340/) — 荷兰弟在洛杉矶首映式强调第四部“更黑暗”，与前三部风格明显分岔，有望吸引更年长观众。
- [Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Voice Gave ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Directors “Chills”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/robert-downey-jr-doctor-doom-voice-russo-brothers-chills-1236657698/) — RDJ首次为毁灭博士配音便让导演“起鸡皮疙瘩”，漫威此次“换角”战略（钢铁侠变反叛）争议与期待并存。
- [Ariana Grande Sues Hackers for Leaking Unreleased Music and Footage](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/ariana-grande-sues-hackers-leaking-unreleased-music-footage-1236822277/) — 诉讼针对多名“无名黑客”，指控其通过钓鱼攻击窃取录音及录像，本案或成音乐领域数字安全判例。
- [Sean Astin Says He “Had to Sell” House Due to Low Pay From ‘Lord of the Rings’](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/sean-astin-sell-house-low-pay-lord-of-the-rings-trilogy-1236657650/) — 山姆扮演者坦言尽管三部曲全球票房29亿美元，自己却因片酬太低被迫卖房，揭露好莱坞分成体系弊端。
- [Justin Baldoni’s Wayfarer Studios Ordered to Pay New York Times $171K in Damages](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/justin-baldoni-wayfarer-studios-pay-new-york-times-damages-1235599463/) — 此前其起诉NYT关于Blake Lively性骚扰报道的诽谤案被驳回，现需支付赔偿金，媒体诉讼反噬风险上升。

**市场信号**：漫威通过RDJ转型和蜘蛛侠成人化探索“后英雄时代”叙事，而好莱坞底层演员收入分配问题再度被推到台前，联盟或需重新审视分成规则。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is buzzing with premieres and legal news. The 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' premiere offered fashion moments and insights into the film's mature tone. Legal disputes include Ariana Grande suing hackers for leaking unreleased material and Justin Baldoni's Wayfarer Studios ordered to pay damages to the New York Times. Netflix announced the release date for Lee Chang-dong's 'Possible Love', and New Line won a bidding war for a horror package.

- [Zendaya Stuns ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Premiere in ‘Abstract’ Spider-Inspired Look](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/zendaya-spider-man-brand-new-day-premiere-dress-law-roach-1236822294/) — Costume designer Law Roach described the look as a 'metamorphosis'.
- [Tom Holland Says ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Is “More Mature”](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-mature-film-1237005340/) — Holland teased a darker theme for the fourth installment.
- [Ariana Grande Sues Hackers for Leaking Unreleased Music and Footage](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/ariana-grande-sues-hackers-leaking-unreleased-music-footage-1236822277/) — Lawsuit targets phishing scams that led to leaks of songs and video footage.
- [Netflix Sets Launch Date for Lee Chang-dong’s Awards Hopeful ‘Possible Love’](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/netflix-lee-chang-dong-possible-love-release-date-1236657709/) — The film premieres at Venice before a global Netflix release on Nov. 6.
- [New Line Wins Heated Bidding War For Theo James Krekis Horror Package ‘Jealous People Are Ugly People’](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jealous-people-are-ugly-people-new-line-theo-james-krekis-1237005009/) — At least 10 parties vied for the project adapted from Krekis' short film.

These developments underscore Hollywood's focus on franchise evolution, intellectual property protection, and auteur-driven awards content.

中国.zh:
### 中国娱乐
中国娱乐圈今天聚焦两大议题：**东野圭吾IP在华处境**与**AI影视的产业化突破**。东野圭吾逝世后，国内影视公司累计购下近20部版权，但据《手机新浪网》报道，“大半压在库房里”，形成“香饽饽”与“库存积压”的冰火两重天——翻拍质量、审查限制、市场口味错位是主因。另一方面，**国内首部AI长片获得备案号并上线爱奇艺**，标志着AI生成内容正式进入主流视频平台，传统影视工业面临“降维冲击”。此外，俄罗斯观众掀起中国剧追看热潮，俄罗斯视频平台对中国剧集采购量大幅提升，成为文化“新三样”输出的缩影。

- [近20部版权落地中国 东野圭吾作品成国内影视“香饽饽”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9sMmdiNUpjLXRLcklmTFBtUFNETVBQZkk4X21UTTZFa1AwdnE0a3lMNFNXLWVuN0lmMmRTYzhBQi1HdTU1UUJVUU9xMHI5SU9yUkxxN1FSVjBLcWJXY2JJMV96c2EtdnktTm5iVmd5UFI) — 东野圭吾生前作品在华被大量采购，但实际拍摄转化率不足三成。
- [中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺 开启AI影视规范化、产业化发展新阶段](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1zdmdKU3lnVURiLXpHYUhIMnJ6SVIxVTF2ZnZ4NHo4bW9vRjVyRFpqMndOb1ptaFhQUC1ScnNsUHc1ems1MWtKNkk4eVdieXYxOWlIZmJIMVVNUHp6VmI0UUFoU0tZdmhDTnZ0NVkwdEpHaXNCU010dA) — 该片获得网络剧片发行许可证，爱奇艺与AI公司联合制作，技术路线为“AI编剧+AI分镜+人工后期润色”。
- [俄罗斯观众掀起追中国剧新热潮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNb2JXekRxeXJLbjNhNTBOQTJMeURSWDA5cHFYV1JFSUZUSUZkUk9PMnd5OF9heHF4ZE4yVzdIa1dkUmQyZnV6QjRHT3VtOVZHcTZBNXV5Um9BRi1XbzA2X2JCNlA5MTlyTmpaQ3NjMFNnNk56WWk5R1pUSlBBZm9XU3hRRUliN2xBVVNN) — 俄罗斯当地平台引进《狂飙》《三体》等剧集，中国剧海外传播从“东南亚热”扩展至东欧。
- [中国文化产业促进会AI影视文旅分会成立大会在杭举行](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNUkZkY2s3cGJiU2xUYWUyXzRIMU5UQjk5eFVwVDBvcVRhcVV2V2ZpSDJkRmpuaGpvc0xPaXBaNGZUTFBPcVBteDJqaEVTREFvTFU5ZE04TURaSkNZZzlGWmlweFlIUERxYXNub2swNFFTNjRaekdlUUl2M2JIZUIxTERibnhCNWxFWTVWYQ) — 同期亮相MovFlow专业级AI影视工业化平台，为AI影视提供底层工具链。

**判断**：东野圭吾IP的“库存危机”若持续，将影响日本IP再售定价。AI长片虽获准入市，但观众是否接受“无人类导演”的内容仍有待检验——该片上线后豆瓣评分与播放量是行业风向标。
中国.en:
China's entertainment industry is undergoing rapid AI integration and grappling with the legacy of Higashino Keigo. The first AI-generated feature film received a distribution license on iQiyi, signaling a new era for AI filmmaking. Nearly 20 Higashino Keigo works have sold rights in China, but many remain unused, creating a bottleneck. Russian audiences are increasingly watching Chinese dramas, highlighting soft power gains.

- [中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺 开启AI影视规范化、产业化发展新阶段 — China's first AI long film obtained a license on iQiyi, marking a milestone for AI in film production and raising questions about traditional industry impact.
